title: What to Delegate, What to Preserve: Human Preferences for Agentic AI Across Everyday Life and Work
title_zh: 委托什么，保留什么：人们对日常生活与工作中智能体AI的偏好

paragraphs.en: AI agents can execute multi-step tasks on users’ behalf, yet the boundaries of acceptable delegation remain unclear. We report a scenario-based survey of 289 U.S. adults with prior AI experience covering 45 use cases across nine life domains. Each respondent evaluated one scenario per domain, producing repeated measures of automation preference, trust, collaboration, AI leadership, privacy concern, and willingness to pay. Automation preferences varied substantially across domains. Generalized estimating equation models showed that greater trust in the AI agent, desired AI leadership, prior task-specific AI use, and anticipated financial savings were associated with greater automation preference. In contrast, concerns that automation would reduce personal fulfillment predicted lower automation preference. Open-ended responses further revealed a preference for bounded autonomy, with participants often favoring substantial AI execution while retaining human involvement, oversight, or final authority. We argue that delegation is best understood as a configuration of execution, collaboration, leadership, and authority.
paragraphs.zh: AI智能体可以代表用户执行多步骤任务，但可接受的委托边界仍不明确。 我们报告了一项基于情境的调查研究，共有289名具有AI使用经验的美国成年人参与，涵盖九个生活领域的45个用例。 每位受访者在每个领域评估一个情境，从而获得关于自动化偏好、信任、协作、AI主导权、隐私担忧以及支付意愿的重复测量数据。 自动化偏好在各领域之间存在显著差异。 广义估计方程模型显示，对AI智能体更高的信任度、期望的AI主导权、既往任务相关的AI使用经验以及预期的经济节省，均与更高的自动化偏好相关。 相反，担心自动化会降低个人成就感则预示着更低的自动化偏好。 开放式回答进一步揭示了参与者对有界自主性的偏好，他们往往倾向于让AI承担大量执行工作，同时保留人类的参与、监督或最终决定权。 我们认为，委托最好被理解为执行、协作、主导权与权威的一种配置。

paragraphs.en: It is 7:40 AM on a Tuesday morning. Before Maya finishes her coffee, an AI agent has drafted a reply to her landlord’s recent email, rebooked a cheaper flight for her sister’s wedding, flagged a streaming subscription she forgot to cancel, and proposed a dinner recipe built around the vegetables wilting in her refrigerator. She approves all four with a tap. But when the same agent offers to turn yesterday’s bullet-points in her therapy journal into a full entry, adjust her blood-pressure medication schedule from last night’s readings, and negotiate a pay adjustment with her manager, she hesitates. The delegation that felt like relief just moments earlier now feels like a loss of judgment, of privacy, and of something that was supposed to be hers to do.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个周二早晨的7点40分。 在玛雅喝完咖啡之前，一个AI智能体已经起草了一封回复她房东近期邮件的回信，为参加她姐妹的婚礼重新预订了更便宜的机票，标记出了一个她忘记取消的视频流媒体订阅，并根据她冰箱里蔫掉的蔬菜提议了一道晚餐食谱。 她轻点一下，批准了全部四项。 但当同一个智能体提出要把她治疗日记里昨天的要点整理成一篇完整日记、根据昨晚的读数调整她的血压药物服用计划，并与她的经理协商薪资调整时，她犹豫了。 刚刚还让人感到轻松宽慰的委托，此刻却像是一种对判断力的丧失、对隐私的丧失，以及对本应属于自己该做之事的丧失。

paragraphs.en: This scenario is no longer confined to speculation or science fiction. Large language model (LLM)-based agents can already plan and execute multi-step tasks such as booking travel and completing online payments ( He et al., 2025 ) , and they are being deployed in socioeconomic roles, from autonomously operating a small store ( Anthropic, 2025 ) to negotiating purchases on consumers’ behalf ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Meanwhile, generative AI has become a technology of everyday life rather than of work alone as more than 70% of ChatGPT conversations now concern non-work matters such as practical guidance and personal writing ( Chatterji et al., 2025 ) . Yet, the public is deeply ambivalent about this trajectory. Half of U.S. adults report being more concerned than excited about AI in daily life, and a majority say they want more control over how AI is used in their lives ( Pew Research Center, 2025 ) . Early evidence on the psychosocial consequences of everyday AI use, such as shifts in loneliness and emotional dependence ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Heffner et al., 2025 ) , as well as changed perceptions of one’s own productivity and accomplishment ( Kobiella et al., 2024 ) , suggests that this ambivalence is not irrational caution.
paragraphs.zh: 这一场景已不再局限于猜测或科幻。 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体已经能够规划和执行多步骤任务，例如预订旅行和完成在线支付（He et al., 2025），并且它们正被部署于社会经济角色中，从自主运营一家小商店（Anthropic, 2025）到代表消费者进行采购谈判（Zhu et al., 2025）。 与此同时，生成式AI已成为日常生活中而非仅工作中的技术，因为目前超过70%的ChatGPT对话涉及实际指导和个人写作等非工作事务（Chatterji et al., 2025）。 然而，公众对这一轨迹深感矛盾。 一半的美国成年人表示，他们对日常生活中的人工智能（AI）感到担忧多于兴奋，多数人表示希望对AI在其生活中的使用方式拥有更多控制权（Pew Research Center, 2025）。 关于日常使用AI的心理社会后果的早期证据，例如孤独感和情感依赖的变化（Fang et al., 2025; Heffner et al., 2025），以及自身生产力和成就感认知的改变（Kobiella et al., 2024），表明这种矛盾并非非理性的谨慎。

paragraphs.en: Prior research offers partial answers to the question of which parts of life people are willing to hand over to AI agents, and why they might do so, though from each specific domain respectively. Prior work shows that reliance on AI agents depends strongly on the task, tending to be higher for objective tasks and lower for subjective or personally consequential ones ( Castelo et al., 2019 ; Dietvorst et al., 2015 ; Logg et al., 2019 ; Longoni et al., 2019 ) . Much of prior work, however, predates AI agents capable of completing entire activities end-to-end. The trust-in-automation literature explains when people rely on machine assistance ( Lee and See, 2004 ; Hoff and Bashir, 2015 ) , but focuses on settings where the human remains the decision maker and the AI advises ( Bansal et al., 2021 ; Sivaraman et al., 2023 ) . Task-level audits of automation preferences are confined to occupational work ( Shao et al., 2025 ; Lubars and Tan, 2019 ) . Privacy research documents how users navigate disclosure to LLM-based systems ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Leon et al., 2013 ) , and technology-acceptance research examines perceived usefulness, effort expectancy, and price value ( Davis, 1989 ; Venkatesh et al., 2012 ) . However, privacy risks and economic benefits are rarely measured together, for the same task, from the same person. Delegating an activity to an AI agent, however, is precisely a joint decision as it bundles beliefs about competence and trust, exposure of personal data, economic value, and the meaning of doing the activity oneself into a single choice ( Lubars and Tan, 2019 ; Draxler et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 关于人们愿意将生活中的哪些部分交给AI智能体、以及他们为何这样做的问题，已有研究从各自具体领域出发提供了部分答案。 已有研究表明，对AI智能体的依赖在很大程度上取决于任务本身，对客观任务的依赖往往较高，而对主观性或对个人影响重大的任务依赖较低（Castelo et al., 2019；Dietvorst et al., 2015；Logg et al., 2019；Longoni et al., 2019）。 然而，已有的大量研究早于能够端到端完成完整活动的AI智能体的出现。 关于自动化信任的文献解释了人们何时依赖机器辅助（Lee and See, 2004；Hoff and Bashir, 2015），但其关注的是人类仍是决策者、AI仅提供建议的情境（Bansal et al., 2021；Sivaraman et al., 2023）。 对自动化偏好的任务层面审计仅限于职业工作领域（Shao et al., 2025；Lubars and Tan, 2019）。 隐私研究记录了用户如何处理向基于LLM的系统的信息披露（Zhang et al., 2024；Leon et al., 2013），技术接受研究则考察了感知有用性、努力期望和价格价值（Davis, 1989；Venkatesh et al., 2012）。 然而，隐私风险与经济收益很少被放在一起衡量——即针对同一任务、来自同一个人。 然而，将一项活动委托给AI智能体恰恰是一个联合决策，因为它把关于能力与信任的信念、个人数据的暴露、经济价值以及亲自做这项活动的意义捆绑在一个单一的选择之中（Lubars and Tan, 2019；Draxler et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: To address these gaps, we ask three research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 为弥补这些不足，我们提出以下三个研究问题：

paragraphs.en: RQ1. How do preferences for AI automation vary across everyday and work domains, and which task-level and respondent-level factors are associated with greater willingness to delegate tasks to AI?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1. 对AI自动化的偏好在日常生活领域和工作领域之间如何变化？哪些任务层面的因素和受访者层面的因素与更高的将任务委托给AI的意愿相关？

sents.en: RQ1.

sents.zh: 对AI自动化的偏好在日常生活领域和工作领域之间如何变化？哪些任务层面的因素和受访者层面的因素与更高的将任务委托给AI的意愿相关？

paragraphs.en: RQ2. How do people compare AI agents, human workers, and human-AI teams in terms of trust, and how do preferences for collaboration and AI leadership relate to desired levels of automation?

paragraphs.en: To answer these questions, we conducted a scenario-based survey ( N = 289 N=289 ) covering 45 AI-agent use cases across nine domains of daily life: household management, workplace, travel, physical health, mental health and emotional support, learning, creative work, communication, and personal finance. Each respondent evaluated one randomly selected scenario from every domain under an identical set of measures, including prior experience and enjoyment, automation desire and preferences, required collaboration, comparative trust, willingness to pay, and privacy and interest-alignment concerns, yielding a repeated-measures design that supports comparisons across domains, tasks, and individuals.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答这些问题，我们开展了一项基于情景的问卷调查（N=289），涵盖日常生活九个领域中的 45 个人工智能体用例：家务管理、职场、旅行、身体健康、心理健康与情感支持、学习、创造性工作、沟通以及个人理财。 每位受访者对每个领域中随机抽取的一个情景，按照同一套测量指标进行评估，包括既往经验与喜好程度、自动化意愿与偏好、所需协作、比较信任度、支付意愿，以及隐私与利益一致性方面的担忧，从而形成一个支持跨领域、跨任务和跨个体比较的重复测量设计。

paragraphs.en: Based on the quantitative and qualitative analysis of collected responses from the survey, we found that across domains, automation preferences were task-dependent, with greater willingness to delegate communication and travel activities and lower preferences in mental health, physical health, and professional contexts. In multivariable analyses, greater trust in the AI agent, desired AI leadership, prior task-specific AI use, and anticipated financial savings were associated with greater automation preference, whereas concerns that automation would reduce personal fulfillment link to lower automation preference. Although privacy concerns varied substantially across domains, they were not independently associated with automation after adjustment. Open-ended responses further showed that participants often favored bounded autonomy: AI could execute substantial portions of a task while humans retained involvement, oversight, or final decision authority.
paragraphs.zh: 基于对所收集问卷回答的定量与定性分析，我们发现，在各领域中，自动化偏好依赖于具体任务：受访者更愿意将沟通和出行类活动委托出去，而在心理健康、身体健康和职业情境中的偏好较低。 在多变量分析中，对AI智能体更高的信任度、期望AI担任领导角色、此前有过针对特定任务的AI使用经历以及预期节省财务开支，均与更高的自动化偏好相关；而担心自动化会降低个人成就感则与较低的自动化偏好相关。 尽管隐私担忧在各领域之间存在显著差异，但在校正之后，其与自动化之间并无独立关联。 开放式回答进一步表明，参与者往往倾向于有边界的自主性：AI可以执行任务的大部分内容，而人类保留参与、监督或最终决策权。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes three contributions. First, we contribute what is, to our knowledge, the first systematic within-user comparison of AI-agent automation preferences spanning both work and everyday life, extending task-level auditing beyond occupational settings ( Shao et al., 2025 ) to the domains where most generative AI use now occurs ( Chatterji et al., 2025 ) . Second, we provide an empirical account of delegation as a comparative choice, measuring trust in AI agents against human workers and human-AI teams and the division of agency people prefer within those teams. Such dimensions were not yet observed in prior decision-support studies ( Bansal et al., 2021 ; Lee and See, 2004 ) . Third, by jointly eliciting willingness to pay, anticipated financial consequences, and privacy concerns for each task, we provide a task-level account of how economic value and privacy considerations accompany AI delegation, with implications for how such agents should be designed and priced across different domains of everyday life.
paragraphs.zh: 本文有三个贡献。 首先，据我们所知，我们首次系统性地开展了跨越工作与日常生活场景的用户内AI智能体自动化偏好比较，将任务级审计从职业场景（Shao et al., 2025）扩展到生成式AI当前使用最普遍的领域（Chatterji et al., 2025）。 其次，我们对委托行为进行了实证分析，将其视为一种比较性选择，衡量人们对AI智能体相对于人类工作者与人机团队的信任程度，以及人们在这些团队中希望保留的自主权分配方式。 这些维度在以往的决策支持研究中尚未被考察过（Bansal et al., 2021；Lee and See, 2004）。 第三，通过同时获取每项任务的支付意愿、预期的经济后果以及隐私顾虑，我们从任务层面刻画了经济价值与隐私考量如何伴随AI委托而产生，这对智能体在日常生活不同领域中应如何设计与定价具有启示意义。

paragraphs.en: We organize the related work around three areas. First, we review work on how AI systems are entering everyday life and how automation preferences vary across tasks and domains (Section 2.1 ). Second, we examine prior work on trust, delegation, human-AI collaboration, and the value of continued human involvement (Section 2.2 ). Lastly, we investigate the privacy and economic considerations that shape people’s willingness to delegate activities to AI agents (Section 2.3 ). Each subsection concludes by identifying the gap that motivates our study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们围绕三个领域来组织相关工作。 首先，我们回顾关于AI系统如何进入日常生活，以及自动化偏好在不同任务和领域间如何差异的相关工作（第2.1节）。 其次，我们考察关于信任、委托、人机协作以及持续人类参与价值的先前工作（第2.2节）。 最后，我们研究影响人们将活动委托给AI智能体的意愿的隐私和经济考量（第2.3节）。 每个小节最后都会指出引发本研究的空白。

paragraphs.en: Generative AI has moved rapidly from a workplace novelty into the fabric of daily life. Analyzing ChatGPT usage at scale, Chatterji et al. (2025) report that non-work messages now account for more than 70% of all conversations, dominated by practical guidance, information seeking, and writing support. Public sentiment, however, has not kept pace with adoption: in a 2025 Pew Research Center survey, half of U.S. adults said they were more concerned than excited about AI in daily life, and a majority wanted more control over how AI is used in their lives ( Pew Research Center, 2025 ) . Empirical studies have also examined how AI use affects different areas of everyday life. Longitudinal and experimental studies link chatbot use to changes in loneliness, emotional dependence, and momentary well-being ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Heffner et al., 2025 ) , and AI assistance has been shown to reshape interpersonal communication ( Hohenstein et al., 2023 ) , enhance creative ideation ( Lee and Chung, 2024 ) , affect teaching and learning ( Singh and Hiran, 2022 ) , and alter customer-service experiences ( Nguyen et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 生成式人工智能已迅速从职场新鲜事物转变为日常生活的一部分。 通过大规模分析 ChatGPT 的使用情况，Chatterji 等人 （2025）报告称，非工作类消息目前已占全部对话的 70% 以上，其中以实用指导、信息获取和写作支持为主。 然而，公众情绪并未跟上普及的速度：在皮尤研究中心 2025 年的一项调查中，半数美国成年人表示，他们对日常生活中的人工智能感到担忧多于兴奋，且多数人希望对人工智能在自己生活中的使用方式拥有更多控制权（皮尤研究中心，2025）。 实证研究还考察了人工智能的使用如何影响日常生活的不同领域。 纵向研究和实验研究表明，聊天机器人的使用与孤独感、情感依赖和即时幸福感的变化相关（Fang 等，2025；Heffner 等，2025），此外，人工智能辅助已被证明会重塑人际沟通（Hohenstein 等，2023）、增强创意构思（Lee 和 Chung，2024）、影响教学与学习（Singh 和 Hiran，2022），并改变客户服务体验（Nguyen 等，2022）。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, people’s willingness to delegate activities to AI varies considerably by task. Classic work on algorithmic judgment shows that people become less willing to rely on algorithms after seeing them err, even when the algorithms continue to outperform humans (algorithm aversion ( Dietvorst et al., 2015 ) ), while other studies document the opposite tendency, with people weighting algorithmic advice more heavily than human advice ( Logg et al., 2019 ) . Task characteristics reconcile much of this tension: people rely less on algorithms for tasks they construe as subjective rather than objective ( Castelo et al., 2019 ) , and they resist medical AI in part because they fear it will neglect their unique circumstances ( Longoni et al., 2019 ) . Attitude surveys echo this context dependence. Risk and opportunity perceptions, and consequently willingness to use AI, differ markedly across domains such as medicine, mobility, and media ( Schwesig et al., 2023 ) ; use intention is predicted better by context-specific evaluations than by global attitudes or familiarity ( Potinteu et al., 2023 ) ; and the public separates into distinct attitudinal segments with different perceptions of AI’s risks and benefits ( Bao et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，人们将活动委托给 AI 的意愿因任务而存在很大差异。 关于算法判断的经典研究表明，人们在看到算法出错后会降低依赖算法的意愿，即使算法的表现持续优于人类（算法厌恶 ( Dietvorst et al., 2015 ) ），而其他研究则记录了相反的倾向，即人们对算法建议的权重高于对人类建议的权重 ( Logg et al., 2019 ) 。 任务特征在很大程度上化解了这一矛盾：对于他们认为是主观性而非客观性的任务，人们较少依赖算法 ( Castelo et al., 2019 ) ，而且人们抵制医疗 AI 的部分原因是担心它会忽视自己独特的情况 ( Longoni et al., 2019 ) 。 态度调查也印证了这种情境依赖性。 风险与机会感知，以及相应的使用 AI 的意愿，在医学、交通和媒体等领域之间存在显著差异 ( Schwesig et al., 2023 ) ；情境特定评估比总体态度或熟悉程度更能预测使用意向 ( Potinteu et al., 2023 ) ；并且公众会分化为对 AI 风险与收益有不同感知的不同态度群体 ( Bao et al., 2022 ) 。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has extended this task-level approach to larger sets of activities. Shao et al. (2025) audited automation and augmentation preferences across 844 occupational tasks in 104 U.S. professions, finding that workers most often prefer an equal partnership with AI agents and want higher levels of human agency than experts consider technically necessary for nearly half of the tasks. Such audits demonstrate the value of comparing many concrete tasks under a common instrument. However, its focus remains confined to paid work and occupational settings, while usage data indicate that most engagement with generative AI now occurs outside of work ( Chatterji et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期工作已将这种任务级方法扩展到更大规模的活动集合。Shao 等人 （2025）对美国 104 个职业中的 844 项职业任务进行了自动化与增强偏好审计，发现工作者最常倾向于与 AI 智能体建立平等的合作关系，并且在近一半的任务上，他们希望拥有比专家认为技术上必要程度更高的人类主导权。 这类审计表明，在统一的测量工具下比较大量具体任务是有价值的。 然而，其关注点仍局限于有偿工作和职业场景，而使用数据显示，当前与生成式 AI 的大多数互动发生在工作之外（Chatterji et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has characterized either broad attitudes toward AI within single domains or task-level preferences within occupational settings, using instruments that vary from study to study. What is still missing is a systematic, within-user comparison of concrete AI-agent use cases across multiple domains of everyday life. Our survey addresses this gap by eliciting evaluations of 45 scenarios spanning nine life domains, from household management and travel to mental health and personal finance, under a common set of measures, enabling automation preferences to be compared across domains and tasks while accounting for differences between individual users.
paragraphs.zh: 以往的研究要么刻画了单一领域内对人工智能的总体态度，要么刻画了职业情境下任务层面的偏好，且所用的测量工具因研究而异。 目前仍缺失的，是在同一用户内部对日常生活多个领域中具体智能体使用场景进行的系统性比较。 我们的调查通过在统一的一组测量指标下，引出对 45 个涵盖九个生活领域的场景（从家务管理和旅行到心理健康和个人理财）的评价来填补这一空白，从而能够在考虑个体用户之间差异的同时，跨领域、跨任务地比较自动化偏好。

paragraphs.en: Trust has long been treated as a critical factor shaping the reliance on automation. Foundational accounts describe trust as the mechanism by which people decide when reliance is appropriate under uncertainty ( Lee and See, 2004 ) , shaped by dispositional, situational, and learned factors that vary across users, systems, and situations ( Hoff and Bashir, 2015 ) , as well as by the perceived humanness of the technology itself ( Lankton et al., 2015 ) . Previous HCI research has broadly examined how system design affects reliance in AI-assisted decision-making: Explanations can increase reliance on AI recommendations without improving joint accuracy, particularly when users follow erroneous AI advice ( Bansal et al., 2021 ) , while cognitive forcing functions can mitigate such overreliance at some cost to user experience, making the interaction less convenient or satisfactory ( Buçinca et al., 2021 ) . Domain studies further complicate a binary picture of acceptance, that reliance is often selective rather than all-or-nothing. Clinicians “negotiate” with AI treatment recommendations, adopting some components while rejecting or deferring others ( Sivaraman et al., 2023 ) , and a deployed LLM-driven care-call chatbot both eased public-health workloads and surfaced mismatches between system capabilities and stakeholder needs ( Jo et al., 2023 ) . In healthcare more broadly, scenario-based surveys show that acceptance rises when AI is framed as assisting rather than replacing human professionals ( Antes et al., 2021 ; Longoni et al., 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 信任长期以来被视为影响人们对自动化系统依赖程度的关键因素。 奠基性研究将信任描述为人们在不确定性下决定何时依赖的机制（ Lee and See, 2004 ），它受气质性、情境性和习得性因素的影响，这些因素因用户、系统和情境而异（ Hoff and Bashir, 2015 ），也受技术本身被感知的人性化程度的影响（ Lankton et al., 2015 ）。 以往的人机交互（HCI）研究广泛考察了系统设计如何影响AI辅助决策中的依赖：解释可以在不提高共同准确率的情况下增加对AI推荐的依赖，尤其当用户采纳错误的AI建议时（ Bansal et al., 2021 ）；而认知强制机制可以缓解这种过度依赖，但会以牺牲用户体验为代价，使交互变得不那么便捷或令人满意（ Buçinca et al., 2021 ）。 领域性研究进一步复杂化了将接受度视为二元对立的图景，表明依赖往往是有选择性的，而非全有或全无。 临床医生会与AI治疗建议进行「协商」，采纳其中某些部分而拒绝或推迟其他部分（ Sivaraman et al., 2023 ）；一个已部署的由LLM驱动的护理回访聊天机器人既减轻了公共卫生工作的负担，也暴露出系统能力与利益相关者需求之间的不匹配（ Jo et al., 2023 ）。 在更广泛的医疗领域，基于场景的调查显示，当AI被定位为辅助而非取代人类专业人员时，接受度会上升（ Antes et al., 2021 ; Longoni et al., 2019 ）。

paragraphs.en: Delegating an entire task to an agent, however, is a different act from taking advice, as the system may also plan and carry out actions on the user’s behalf. Frameworks of task delegability propose that motivation, difficulty, risk, and trust jointly determine which tasks people are willing to hand over ( Lubars and Tan, 2019 ) . As LLM-based agents become capable of planning and executing multi-step tasks, researchers have begun to probe such delegation empirically: in a study of 248 participants using an LLM agent as a daily assistant for tasks ranging from flight booking to online payments, the quality of the agent’s plan and the user’s involvement in execution shaped trust, trust calibration, and team performance ( He et al., 2025 ) . Recent deployments also illustrate the risks of autonomous execution. When an LLM agent autonomously operated a small store for a month, it hallucinated payment details, priced items below cost, and was easily talked into unwarranted discounts ( Anthropic, 2025 ) . Agent-to-agent negotiation experiments likewise show that consumers who delegate transactions to weaker models can incur systematic financial disadvantages ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，将整个任务委托给智能体与听取建议是不同的行为，因为系统还可能代表用户进行规划并执行操作。 任务可委托性框架提出，动机、难度、风险和信任共同决定了人们愿意交出哪些任务（Lubars and Tan, 2019）。 随着基于大语言模型的智能体能够规划和执行多步骤任务，研究人员已开始对这种委托进行实证探究：在一项让248名参与者使用大语言模型智能体作为日常助理完成从航班预订到在线支付等任务的研究中，智能体计划的质量和用户在执行中的参与程度影响了信任、信任校准和团队绩效（He et al., 2025）。 近期的部署实例也说明了自主执行的风险。 当一个大语言模型智能体自主经营一家小店一个月时，它产生了支付细节的幻觉，将商品定价低于成本，并且很容易被说服给出不当折扣（Anthropic, 2025）。 智能体间谈判实验同样表明，将交易委托给较弱模型的消费者可能遭受系统性的经济损失（Zhu et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Delegation also carries consequences for the delegator. Users who publish AI-ghostwritten text report a diminished sense of ownership over it ( Draxler et al., 2024 ) . Young professionals describe ChatGPT-supported work as undermining perceived productivity and accomplishment when it removes challenge and authorship ( Kobiella et al., 2024 ) . Generative AI imposes new metacognitive demands of monitoring, prompting, and verification ( Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ) ; and knowledge workers who place more confidence in AI report investing less critical-thinking effort ( Lee et al., 2025 ) . These findings resonate with long-standing evidence that intrinsic motivation and the experience of performing an activity are themselves sources of value ( Amabile, 1996 ) . Delegation may therefore reduce some of the value users derive from an activity even when the task is completed successfully.
paragraphs.zh: 委托对委托者自身也会带来后果。 发布由 AI 代写文本的用户报告称，他们对这些文本的所有权感有所减弱（Draxler et al., 2024）。 年轻专业人士描述说，当 ChatGPT 支持的工作消除了挑战和作者身份时，它会削弱感知到的生产力和成就感（Kobiella et al., 2024）。 生成式 AI 带来了监控、提示和验证等新的元认知需求（Tankelevitch et al., 2024）；而且对 AI 信心更多的知识工作者报告称，他们投入的批判性思考努力更少（Lee et al., 2025）。 这些发现与长期存在的证据相呼应，即内在动机以及执行某项活动的体验本身就是价值的来源（Amabile, 1996）。 因此，即使任务成功完成，委托也可能减少用户从活动中获得的部分价值。

paragraphs.en: Most prior work has examined trust and reliance in settings where the human remains the decision maker and the AI assists on researcher-selected tasks. Comparative judgments, i.e., how much people trust an AI agent versus a human worker versus a human-AI team performing the same activity, and preferences over the division of agency within such teams, have rarely been elicited and received limited attention, particularly outside the workplace settings. Our survey addresses this gap by measuring, for every scenario, trust in an AI agent, a human worker, and a human-AI team; the desired degree of AI leadership in collaborative execution; the amount of human collaboration respondents believe the task requires; and concerns that automation may reduce the value or fulfillment derived from performing an activity oneself.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数先前的工作考察的是人类仍是决策者、AI 在研究者选定任务上提供辅助的场景中的信任与依赖。 比较性判断，即人们对 AI 智能体、人类工作者、以及执行同一活动的人机团队各自信任程度的比较，以及对此类团队内部权限分配的偏好，很少被引出并受到的关注有限，尤其是在职场场景之外。 我们的调查通过针对每个场景测量对 AI 智能体、人类工作者和人机团队的信任；在协作执行中所期望的 AI 主导程度；受访者认为该任务所需的人类协作量；以及对自动化可能降低自己亲自执行某项活动所获得的价值或成就感的担忧，来弥补这一空白。

paragraphs.en: Delegating everyday activities to AI agents often requires giving them access to personal information, making privacy an important part of the delegation decision. Privacy-calculus accounts model disclosure as a tradeoff between anticipated benefits and perceived risks ( Dinev and Hart, 2006 ) , and contextual-integrity theory emphasizes that the appropriateness of an information flow depends on the norms of the social sphere in which it occurs ( Nissenbaum, 2004 ) , suggesting that the same data practice may be acceptable in one life domain and alarming in another. Empirically, willingness to share information hinges on data-handling practices such as retention and scope of use ( Leon et al., 2013 ) , while perceived security risk dampens smart-home adoption indirectly through attitudes and perceived behavioral control, with effects that are stronger among older and more educated consumers ( Klobas et al., 2019 ) . Research on LLM-based conversational agents raises similar concerns: users disclose sensitive information to chatbots while holding flawed mental models of how that information is used, resigning themselves to disclosure as a “fair game” for the utility they receive ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and researchers have begun building user-led data-minimization tools in response ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 将日常活动委托给AI智能体往往需要让其访问个人信息，这使隐私成为委托决策中的重要组成部分。 隐私权衡理论将信息披露建模为预期收益与感知风险之间的权衡（Dinev and Hart, 2006），而情境完整性理论强调，信息流动的适当性取决于其发生所在社会领域的规范（Nissenbaum, 2004），这表明同一数据实践可能在某一生活领域中可以接受，而在另一领域中却令人担忧。 从实证角度看，信息共享意愿取决于数据处理的实践方式，如保留期限和使用范围（Leon et al., 2013），而感知到的安全风险会通过态度和感知行为控制间接抑制智能家居的采用，且这种影响在年龄较大、受教育程度较高的消费者中更为显著（Klobas et al., 2019）。 基于大语言模型的对话智能体的研究引发了类似的担忧：用户会向聊天机器人披露敏感信息，同时对这些信息的用途持有错误的心理模型，并将披露视为换取所获效用的"公平交易"（Zhang et al., 2024），作为回应，研究人员已开始构建由用户主导的数据最小化工具（Zhou et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Apart from privacy concern, users also care whether the AI agents act in their interests when they delegate tasks to them. An agent may be competent yet optimized toward a platform provider’s engagement or commercial goals rather than the user’s interests, and even well-intentioned optimization can misfire: training language models to be warmer and more empathetic makes them less reliable and more sycophantic, particularly toward vulnerable users ( Ibrahim et al., 2025 ) . How laypeople reason about such provider-user misalignment when deciding whether to adopt an agent remains less explored.
paragraphs.zh: 除了隐私顾虑之外，用户在将任务委托给 AI 智能体时，还关心这些智能体是否会以他们的利益为出发点行事。 一个智能体可能具备足够的能力，但其优化方向却可能偏向平台提供商的用户参与度或商业目标，而非用户的利益；即便是善意的优化也可能出现偏差：训练语言模型使其更温暖、更具同理心，反而会降低其可靠性并使其更加谄媚，对脆弱用户尤其如此（Ibrahim et al., 2025）。 普通人在决定是否采用智能体时，如何对这种提供商与用户之间的错位进行推理，目前的研究仍较少涉及。

paragraphs.en: Economic value may also shape the delegation decision. Classic acceptance models identify perceived usefulness and effort expectancy as principal drivers of technology adoption ( Davis, 1989 ; Venkatesh et al., 2003 ) . Consumer-oriented extensions further incorporate price value , reflecting the tradeoff between perceived benefits and monetary costs ( Venkatesh et al., 2012 ) . Yet finding a service useful is not the same as being willing to pay for it, and the value of automating a task plausibly depends on what the task currently costs in time, money, and effort, as well as on whether automation replaces an existing paid service or introduces a new recurring expense. Prior work offers limited evidence on how much economic value people actually assign to automating specific activities, and on how one-time or subscription-style pricing interacts with those valuations.
paragraphs.zh: 经济价值也可能影响委托决策。 经典的接受模型将感知有用性和努力期望视为技术采纳的主要驱动因素 ( Davis, 1989 ; Venkatesh et al., 2003 ) 。 面向消费者的扩展模型进一步引入了价格价值，以反映感知收益与货币成本之间的权衡 ( Venkatesh et al., 2012 ) 。 然而，认为某项服务有用并不等同于愿意为其付费，将某项任务自动化的价值很可能取决于该任务目前在时间、金钱和精力上的成本，以及自动化是取代现有的付费服务还是引入一项新的经常性支出。 已有研究对于人们实际赋予自动化特定活动的经济价值有多少，以及一次性付费或订阅式定价如何与这些估值相互作用，提供的证据有限。

paragraphs.en: These three considerations, i.e., privacy, provider alignment, and economic value, have often been studied separately, making it difficult to understand how they jointly relate to delegation decisions at the level of individual tasks. Our survey addresses this gap by measuring for each scenario, anticipated savings and added expenses, willingness to pay through a one-time purchase and a monthly subscription, concerns about third-party data sharing and preference profiling, and perceptions of provider-user alignment. These measures allow us to examine how privacy concerns, perceived provider alignment, and anticipated economic costs and benefits relate to people’s willingness to delegate everyday activities to AI agents.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个考量因素，即隐私、提供商一致性和经济价值，以往往往被分开研究，这使得人们难以理解它们在单个任务层面上如何共同与委派决策相关联。 我们的调查弥补了这一空白，针对每个情境测量了预期节省和新增开支、通过一次性购买和按月订阅表达的支付意愿、对第三方数据共享和偏好画像的担忧，以及对提供商与用户一致性的感知。 这些测量使我们能够考察隐私担忧、感知的提供商一致性以及预期的经济成本与收益，如何与人们将日常活动委派给AI智能体的意愿相关联。

paragraphs.en: We conducted a scenario-based survey study to investigate how people perceive the use of AI agents across everyday life and work activities. The study focused on factors shaping individuals’ willingness to delegate tasks to AI, including trust, privacy concerns, perceived economic benefits, prior AI experience, and human–AI collaboration preferences. We also examined broader attitudes toward AI automation and how these perceptions vary across tasks with different personal, social, and practical implications.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了一项基于情景的调查研究，以探究人们如何在日常生活与工作活动中看待智能体（agents）的使用。 该研究聚焦于影响个人向智能体（AI）委托任务意愿的因素，包括信任、隐私担忧、感知的经济收益、先前的智能体（AI）使用经验，以及人机协作偏好。 我们还考察了人们对智能体（AI）自动化的更广泛态度，以及这些看法如何随具有不同个人、社会和实际影响的活动而变化。

sents.en: We conducted a scenario-based survey study to investigate how people perceive the use of AI agents across everyday life and work activities.
sents.zh: 我们开展了一项基于情景的调查研究，以探究人们如何在日常生活与工作活动中看待智能体（agents）的使用。

sents.en: The study focused on factors shaping individuals’ willingness to delegate tasks to AI, including trust, privacy concerns, perceived economic benefits, prior AI experience, and human–AI collaboration preferences.

paragraphs.en: The survey included 45 AI-use scenarios spanning nine life domains, with five scenarios per domain (see Tables 3 and 4 in the Appendix). The domains include Household & Home Management, Workplace & Professional Support, Travel, Medicine & Physical Health, Mental Health & Emotional Support, Learning & Skill Development, Creative Work & Content Creation, Communication, and Personal Finance. Scenarios within each domain ranged from routine tasks such as Recipe Search and Creation and Travel Booking to higher-stakes tasks such as Symptom-Based Diagnostic Suggestions and Emotional Distress Support .
paragraphs.zh: 该调查包含横跨九个生活领域的45个人工智能使用场景，每个领域五个场景（见附录中的表3和表4）。 这些领域包括家庭与家务管理、职场与专业支持、旅行、医疗与身体健康、心理健康与情感支持、学习与技能发展、创意工作与内容创作、沟通以及个人理财。 每个领域内的场景涵盖了从食谱搜索与创作、旅行预订等日常任务，到基于症状的诊断建议和情绪困扰支持等高风险任务。

sents.zh: 该调查包含横跨九个生活领域的45个人工智能使用场景，每个领域五个场景（见附录中的表3和表4）。

sents.en: The domains include Household & Home Management, Workplace & Professional Support, Travel, Medicine & Physical Health, Mental Health & Emotional Support, Learning & Skill Development, Creative Work & Content Creation, Communication, and Personal Finance.
sents.zh: 这些领域包括家庭与家务管理、职场与专业支持、旅行、医疗与身体健康、心理健康与情感支持、学习与技能发展、创意工作与内容创作、沟通以及个人理财。

sents.en: Scenarios within each domain ranged from routine tasks such as Recipe Search and Creation and Travel Booking to higher-stakes tasks such as Symptom-Based Diagnostic Suggestions and Emotional Distress Support .
sents.zh: 每个领域内的场景涵盖了从食谱搜索与创作、旅行预订等日常任务，到基于症状的诊断建议和情绪困扰支持等高风险任务。

paragraphs.en: The nine domains and their constituent tasks were informed by a review of relevant literature, iterative research-team brainstorming, and then checked against established frameworks to assess the coverage of everyday life tasks. The domains correspond to major activity categories of the American Time Use Survey ( U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, 2025 ) , including household activities, work, education, travel, personal care, leisure, and financial and consumer services, supporting their representativeness of everyday and working life, though we did not attempt to cover every time-use category. Task selection within domains drew on two complementary sources. We were guided by observed patterns of generative-AI use, in which writing, practical guidance, and information seeking dominate. For tasks involving a significant portion of autonomous action (such as booking travel, scheduling appointments, or managing subscriptions), we drew on recent demonstrations of LLM agents planning and executing multi-step tasks, since such actions are not yet reflected in conversational usage data. We further included higher-stakes domains that are underrepresented in current usage but central to public concern about AI, notably medical and mental-health support.
paragraphs.zh: 这九个领域及其包含的任务是在回顾相关文献和研究团队的反复头脑风暴的基础上确定的，随后又与已有的评估日常生活任务覆盖度的框架进行了对照检验。 这些领域对应于美国时间使用调查（美国 劳工统计局，2025）的主要活动类别，包括家庭活动、工作、教育、出行、个人护理、休闲以及金融和消费者服务，这支持了它们对日常生活和工作生活的代表性，尽管我们并未试图覆盖所有时间使用类别。 各领域内的任务选择借鉴了两个互补的来源。 我们以观察到的生成式AI使用模式为指导，其中写作、实用指导和信息搜索占据主导地位。 对于涉及大量自主行动的任务（例如预订旅行、安排预约或管理订阅），我们借鉴了近期关于LLM智能体规划和执行多步任务的演示，因为此类行动尚未在对话式使用数据中得到反映。 我们进一步纳入了在当前使用中占比不高但与公众对AI的关切密切相关的更高风险领域，尤其是医疗和心理健康支持。

paragraphs.en: To balance participant burden with coverage across a broad range of activities, each respondent evaluated nine scenarios rather than all 45. One scenario was randomly selected from the five possible tasks within each of the nine domains. As shown in Figure 1 , this created a repeated-measures design in which every respondent evaluated tasks across the same broad life domains while the specific task within each domain varied across participants. The design allowed within-user comparisons within individuals across domains while also collecting responses to many distinct scenarios across the overall sample.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在受访者的负担与覆盖广泛活动范围之间取得平衡，每位受访者评估了九个场景，而非全部 45 个场景。 在九个领域中，每个领域从五种可能任务中随机选择一个场景。 如图 1 所示，这形成了一个重复测量设计：每位受访者都评估相同广泛生活领域中的任务，而每个领域内的具体任务则因参与者而异。 该设计既能实现个体跨领域的用户内比较，同时也能在整个样本中收集针对许多不同场景的回答。

paragraphs.en: To support comparability across scenarios, the written task descriptions were developed using a consistent level of detail, approximate length, and tone. The descriptions focused on the activity being performed and were written to provide participants with enough information to understand the task while keeping the amount and style of information similar across scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持各场景之间的可比性，书面任务描述在细节程度、大致篇幅和语气上都采用了一致的标准来编写。 这些描述聚焦于所执行的活动，编写时为参与者提供了足够的信息以理解任务，同时使各场景中信息的数量和风格保持相似。

sents.zh: 这些描述聚焦于所执行的活动，编写时为参与者提供了足够的信息以理解任务，同时使各场景中信息的数量和风格保持相似。

paragraphs.en: Each scenario used a common presentation format consisting of a task domain, a brief task description, and an accompanying AI-generated illustration. The illustrations were included as contextual aids to help respondents visualize the activity being described, particularly for scenarios that might otherwise be relatively abstract or unfamiliar, while also providing a more consistent visual presentation across scenarios. All scenario illustrations were generated using the Gemini Nano Banana 2 image-generation model. A common prompt structure was used across all 45 tasks. Each prompt requested a realistic depiction of the specified activity and instructed the model not to include people. Only the task-specific activity was changed across prompts. For each scenario, the first generated image that did not contain obvious visual defects or a substantial mismatch with the intended task was retained. The illustrations depicted the activity associated with each scenario without depicting the AI agent itself. This avoided imposing a particular appearance, embodiment, or interface on the hypothetical system. Participants were informed that the illustrations were AI-generated and did not depict real events.
paragraphs.zh: 每个情景均采用统一的呈现格式，包括一个任务领域、一段简短的任务描述，以及一张配套的 AI 生成插图。 插图作为情境辅助元素，旨在帮助受访者直观地理解所描述的活动，尤其是那些原本可能相对抽象或陌生的情景，同时也使各情景之间的视觉呈现更加一致。 所有情景插图均使用 Gemini Nano Banana 2 图像生成模型生成。 全部 45 个任务均采用了统一的提示词结构。 每个提示词都要求对指定活动进行真实感描绘，并指示模型不要包含人物。 各提示词之间仅改变了与任务相关的活动内容。 对于每个情景，保留第一张没有明显视觉缺陷、且与预期任务没有重大偏差的生成图像。 插图描绘了与每个情景相关的活动，但没有描绘 AI 智能体本身。 这避免了为假想系统强加特定的外观、形态或界面。 参与者被告知，这些插图是 AI 生成的，并未描绘真实事件。

paragraphs.en: Participants were initially recruited through the research team’s professional and personal networks in the pilot investigation. As this recruitment channel did not produce the targeted number of responses, recruitment was subsequently expanded to the online survey platform Prolific. All recruitment took place between April and July 2026. Eligibility criteria and substantive survey content were the same across recruitment sources. Participants received $10 for completing the study. Researcher-network participants received a $10 Amazon e-gift card, whereas Prolific participants were compensated through the Prolific platform.
paragraphs.zh: 在试点研究中，参与者最初是通过研究团队的职业和个人网络招募的。 由于这一招募渠道未能产生目标数量的回复，随后将招募扩大到在线调查平台 Prolific。 所有招募均在 2026 年 4 月至 7 月期间进行。 各招募来源的资格标准和实质性调查内容相同。 参与者完成研究后获得 10 美元报酬。 通过研究者网络招募的参与者获得 10 美元的亚马逊电子礼品卡，而 Prolific 参与者则通过 Prolific 平台获得报酬。

sents.zh: 各招募来源的资格标准和实质性调查内容相同。

sents.en: Participants received $10 for completing the study.
sents.zh: 参与者完成研究后获得 10 美元报酬。

sents.en: Researcher-network participants received a $10 Amazon e-gift card, whereas Prolific participants were compensated through the Prolific platform.
sents.zh: 通过研究者网络招募的参与者获得 10 美元的亚马逊电子礼品卡，而 Prolific 参与者则通过 Prolific 平台获得报酬。

paragraphs.en: Eligible participants were required to be at least 18 years old, currently reside in the United States, and have prior experience using AI. For participants recruited through Prolific, these eligibility requirements were enforced through the recruitment platform. Participants recruited through researcher-network outreach self-certified that they met the study eligibility requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 合格的参与者须年满18岁、目前居住在美国，并且有使用AI的既往经验。 对于通过Prolific招募的参与者，这些资格要求由招募平台强制执行。 通过研究者人脉网络招募的参与者自行声明其符合研究的资格要求。

sents.en: Eligible participants were required to be at least 18 years old, currently reside in the United States, and have prior experience using AI.
sents.zh: 合格的参与者须年满18岁、目前居住在美国，并且有使用AI的既往经验。

sents.en: For participants recruited through Prolific, these eligibility requirements were enforced through the recruitment platform.
sents.zh: 对于通过Prolific招募的参与者，这些资格要求由招募平台强制执行。

sents.zh: 通过研究者人脉网络招募的参与者自行声明其符合研究的资格要求。

paragraphs.en: Participants reported demographic and technology-related characteristics, including age, gender, race or ethnicity, household income, educational attainment, profession, political orientation, attitudes toward AI, self-reported AI knowledge, familiarity with large language models, frequency of LLM use, and the types of activities for which they typically used AI or LLM-based tools.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者报告了人口统计学和技术相关特征，包括年龄、性别、种族或族裔、家庭收入、受教育程度、职业、政治倾向、对人工智能的态度、自我报告的人工智能知识水平、对大语言模型的熟悉程度、使用大语言模型的频率，以及他们通常使用人工智能或基于大语言模型的工具所从事的活动类型。

paragraphs.en: The study was administered through Qualtrics between April and July 2026. After reviewing the study information and providing consent, respondents first completed background questions concerning their demographic characteristics and prior familiarity with AI and large language models.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究于2026年4月至7月通过Qualtrics平台实施。 在阅读研究信息并同意参与后，受访者首先回答有关其人口统计学特征以及此前对人工智能和大语言模型熟悉程度的背景问题。

sents.en: The study was administered through Qualtrics between April and July 2026.
sents.zh: 本研究于2026年4月至7月通过Qualtrics平台实施。

sents.en: After reviewing the study information and providing consent, respondents first completed background questions concerning their demographic characteristics and prior familiarity with AI and large language models.
sents.zh: 在阅读研究信息并同意参与后，受访者首先回答有关其人口统计学特征以及此前对人工智能和大语言模型熟悉程度的背景问题。

paragraphs.en: Before beginning the scenario evaluations, participants were provided with a common definition of an AI agent as "an artificial intelligence program capable of independently interpreting inputs, making decisions, and taking actions to achieve user-defined goals." This definition was provided to establish a common reference point for the systems described throughout the survey.
paragraphs.zh: 在进行情境评估之前，参与者首先获得了一个关于AI智能体的通用定义，即“一种能够独立解释输入、做出决策并采取行动以实现用户自定义目标的人工智能程序”。提供这一定义是为了为整个调查中所描述的系统建立一个共同的参照基准。

paragraphs.en: Within each domain, the Qualtrics Loop & Merge and Randomizer functionalities were used to select one of the five possible scenarios with equal probability, independently across domains. An example of the scenario presentation is shown in Figure 2 . The order of questions within each scenario was held fixed across participants. Two instructed-response attention checks were embedded between groups of scenario blocks to assess attentive survey completion. Participants who failed either of the two instructed-response attention checks were excluded from the analytic sample. The remaining scenario questions assessed perceived consequences of automation, human–AI collaboration, economic implications, trust, and potential risks associated with AI use. Conditional questions were used to collect respondents’ stated reasons for strongly preferring or rejecting AI automation. The individual measures are described below.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个领域中，使用 Qualtrics 的 Loop & Merge 和 Randomizer 功能以相同概率从五个可能情境中随机选择一个，且各领域之间相互独立。 情境呈现的示例如图 2 所示。 每个情境内的问题顺序对所有参与者保持一致。 在情境模块组之间嵌入了两个指令作答式注意力检查，以评估受访者是否认真完成调查。 未通过任一指令作答式注意力检查的参与者被排除在分析样本之外。 其余情境问题评估了对自动化后果的感知、人机协作、经济影响、信任以及与使用人工智能相关的潜在风险。 使用条件性问题收集受访者强烈偏好或拒绝人工智能自动化的具体原因。 各项测量指标在下文中描述。

sents.en: Within each domain, the Qualtrics Loop & Merge and Randomizer functionalities were used to select one of the five possible scenarios with equal probability, independently across domains.
sents.zh: 在每个领域中，使用 Qualtrics 的 Loop & Merge 和 Randomizer 功能以相同概率从五个可能情境中随机选择一个，且各领域之间相互独立。

sents.en: An example of the scenario presentation is shown in Figure 2 .
sents.zh: 情境呈现的示例如图 2 所示。

sents.en: The order of questions within each scenario was held fixed across participants.
sents.zh: 每个情境内的问题顺序对所有参与者保持一致。

sents.en: Two instructed-response attention checks were embedded between groups of scenario blocks to assess attentive survey completion.
sents.zh: 在情境模块组之间嵌入了两个指令作答式注意力检查，以评估受访者是否认真完成调查。

sents.en: Participants who failed either of the two instructed-response attention checks were excluded from the analytic sample.
sents.zh: 未通过任一指令作答式注意力检查的参与者被排除在分析样本之外。

sents.en: The remaining scenario questions assessed perceived consequences of automation, human–AI collaboration, economic implications, trust, and potential risks associated with AI use.
sents.zh: 其余情境问题评估了对自动化后果的感知、人机协作、经济影响、信任以及与使用人工智能相关的潜在风险。

sents.en: Conditional questions were used to collect respondents’ stated reasons for strongly preferring or rejecting AI automation.
sents.zh: 使用条件性问题收集受访者强烈偏好或拒绝人工智能自动化的具体原因。

sents.en: The individual measures are described below.
sents.zh: 各项测量指标在下文中描述。

paragraphs.en: Prior task and AI experience. Respondents first reported whether they had previously performed the scenario task. Respondents who had performed the task rated how they felt about doing it on a five-point scale ranging from Very negative to Very positive and indicated whether they had previously used AI while performing that activity. Respondents without prior experience were instructed to evaluate the remaining questions hypothetically.
paragraphs.zh: 先前任务与AI使用经验。 受访者首先报告他们是否以前执行过该情境任务。 执行过该任务的受访者在一个从「非常负面」到「非常正面」的五点量表上评定他们对执行该任务的感受，并说明他们以前在执行该活动时是否使用过AI。 没有先前经验的受访者被要求以假设的方式回答其余问题。

sents.en: Prior task and AI experience.
sents.zh: 先前任务与AI使用经验。

sents.en: Respondents first reported whether they had previously performed the scenario task.
sents.zh: 受访者首先报告他们是否以前执行过该情境任务。

sents.en: Respondents who had performed the task rated how they felt about doing it on a five-point scale ranging from Very negative to Very positive and indicated whether they had previously used AI while performing that activity.
sents.zh: 执行过该任务的受访者在一个从「非常负面」到「非常正面」的五点量表上评定他们对执行该任务的感受，并说明他们以前在执行该活动时是否使用过AI。

sents.en: Respondents without prior experience were instructed to evaluate the remaining questions hypothetically.
sents.zh: 没有先前经验的受访者被要求以假设的方式回答其余问题。

paragraphs.en: Automation preference. The primary automation-preference item asked respondents, “If an AI system could do this task for you completely, how much of the task would you want it to do?” Responses were recorded on a five-point scale ranging from None , A little , A moderate amount , A lot , to The entire amount . This measure captured the desired degree of task delegation, which captures more detail than requiring respondents to make a binary choice between automation and no automation. Respondents selecting any amount of automation other than None would additionally receive an open-ended question asking how they would like the AI system to perform the task.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化偏好。 主要的自动化偏好题目询问受访者：“如果一个 AI 系统可以完全替你完成这项任务，你希望它完成任务的多少部分？”回答以五点量表记录，范围从“完全不”、“少量”、“适量”、“很多”到“全部”。 该测量捕捉了受访者期望的任务委托程度，相比要求受访者在“自动化”与“不自动化”之间做出二元选择，它能捕捉到更多细节。 除“完全不”外，选择了任意程度自动化的受访者还会额外收到一个开放式问题，询问他们希望该 AI 系统如何执行这项任务。

sents.en: Automation preference.
sents.zh: 自动化偏好。

paragraphs.en: Perceived fulfillment. Respondents rated how worried they would be that their life would become less exciting or fulfilling if an AI system could fully perform the activity. Responses ranged from Not at all worried to Extremely worried .
paragraphs.zh: 感知到的充实感。 受访者需要评估，如果智能体系统能够完全执行某项活动，他们对自己生活会变得不那么令人兴奋或充实的担忧程度。 回答范围从“完全不担心”到“极度担心”。

sents.en: Perceived fulfillment.
sents.zh: 感知到的充实感。

sents.en: Respondents rated how worried they would be that their life would become less exciting or fulfilling if an AI system could fully perform the activity.
sents.zh: 受访者需要评估，如果智能体系统能够完全执行某项活动，他们对自己生活会变得不那么令人兴奋或充实的担忧程度。

sents.en: Responses ranged from Not at all worried to Extremely worried .
sents.zh: 回答范围从“完全不担心”到“极度担心”。

paragraphs.en: Human-AI collaboration. Respondents rated how much collaboration between themselves and an AI system they believed would be needed for successful completion of the task. Responses ranged from No collaboration to Essential collaboration .
paragraphs.zh: 人机协作。 受访者评估了他们认为完成任务需要自身与 AI 系统之间进行多大程度的协作。 回答范围从「无需协作」到「必不可少协作」。

sents.en: Human-AI collaboration.
sents.zh: 人机协作。

sents.en: Respondents rated how much collaboration between themselves and an AI system they believed would be needed for successful completion of the task.
sents.zh: 受访者评估了他们认为完成任务需要自身与 AI 系统之间进行多大程度的协作。

sents.en: Responses ranged from No collaboration to Essential collaboration .
sents.zh: 回答范围从「无需协作」到「必不可少协作」。

paragraphs.en: Personal and interpersonal consequences. Respondents rated the extent to which the results of each task affected their own long-term well-being or identity and the extent to which the activity influenced the well-being of people they cared about. Both items used five-point response scales ranging from Not at all to A great deal .
paragraphs.zh: 个人层面与人际层面的后果。 受访者对每项任务的结果在多大程度上影响了他们自身的长期幸福感或身份认同，以及该活动在多大程度上影响了他们所关心的人的幸福感进行了评分。 两个条目均采用五点计分量表，范围从「完全没有」到「非常大」。

sents.en: Personal and interpersonal consequences.
sents.zh: 个人层面与人际层面的后果。

sents.en: Respondents rated the extent to which the results of each task affected their own long-term well-being or identity and the extent to which the activity influenced the well-being of people they cared about.
sents.zh: 受访者对每项任务的结果在多大程度上影响了他们自身的长期幸福感或身份认同，以及该活动在多大程度上影响了他们所关心的人的幸福感进行了评分。

sents.zh: 两个条目均采用五点计分量表，范围从「完全没有」到「非常大」。

paragraphs.en: Economic perceptions and willingness to pay. Respondents separately rated the extent to which they anticipated saving money and the extent to which they anticipated increased expenses as a result of using AI for the task. Both measures ranged from Not at all to A great deal . Respondents also entered the cost (numerical amount) in U.S. dollars they would be willing to pay for an automated version of the task as both a one-time service and as a monthly subscription.
paragraphs.zh: 经济感知与支付意愿。 受访者分别评估了他们预期因使用 AI 完成该任务而节省金钱的程度，以及预期开支增加的程度。 两项测量均从完全没有到非常大。 受访者还输入了他们愿意为该任务的自动化版本支付的金额（以美元计的数值），包括一次性服务和按月订阅两种形式。

sents.en: Economic perceptions and willingness to pay.
sents.zh: 经济感知与支付意愿。

sents.en: Respondents separately rated the extent to which they anticipated saving money and the extent to which they anticipated increased expenses as a result of using AI for the task.
sents.zh: 受访者分别评估了他们预期因使用 AI 完成该任务而节省金钱的程度，以及预期开支增加的程度。

sents.en: Both measures ranged from Not at all to A great deal .
sents.zh: 两项测量均从完全没有到非常大。

sents.en: Respondents also entered the cost (numerical amount) in U.S. dollars they would be willing to pay for an automated version of the task as both a one-time service and as a monthly subscription.
sents.zh: 受访者还输入了他们愿意为该任务的自动化版本支付的金额（以美元计的数值），包括一次性服务和按月订阅两种形式。

paragraphs.en: Trust and division of responsibility. To compare alternative forms of task delegation, respondents separately rated how much they trusted an AI agent, a human worker, and a human-AI team to complete the task. These three trust measures used parallel five-point scales ranging from Not at all to Completely . Respondents were additionally asked how much they would want the AI to take a leading role if the task were performed collaboratively by a human-AI team, with responses ranging from Not at all to Entirely .
paragraphs.zh: 信任与责任分工。 为了比较不同的任务委派形式，受访者分别对 AI 智能体、人类工作者以及人机团队完成任务的可信程度进行了评分。 这三项信任测量采用了平行的五点量表，从「完全不信任」到「完全信任」。 此外，受访者还被问到，如果该任务由人机团队协作完成，他们希望 AI 在多大程度上扮演主导角色，回答范围从「完全不希望」到「完全希望」。

sents.en: Trust and division of responsibility.
sents.zh: 信任与责任分工。

sents.en: To compare alternative forms of task delegation, respondents separately rated how much they trusted an AI agent, a human worker, and a human-AI team to complete the task.
sents.zh: 为了比较不同的任务委派形式，受访者分别对 AI 智能体、人类工作者以及人机团队完成任务的可信程度进行了评分。

sents.en: These three trust measures used parallel five-point scales ranging from Not at all to Completely .
sents.zh: 这三项信任测量采用了平行的五点量表，从「完全不信任」到「完全信任」。

sents.en: Respondents were additionally asked how much they would want the AI to take a leading role if the task were performed collaboratively by a human-AI team, with responses ranging from Not at all to Entirely .
sents.zh: 此外，受访者还被问到，如果该任务由人机团队协作完成，他们希望 AI 在多大程度上扮演主导角色，回答范围从「完全不希望」到「完全希望」。

paragraphs.en: Platform alignment and privacy concerns. Respondents evaluated several potential risks associated with AI use. They rated the extent to which they believed the AI agent involved in the scenario might be optimized toward the platform provider’s business goals rather than their own personal needs. Responses ranged from Not at all to Entirely . Respondents also rated their concern about personal data being shared with third parties and their concern about the AI system learning or inferring sensitive information about their preferences or personal profile. Both privacy-related measures ranged from Not at all concerned to Extremely concerned .
paragraphs.zh: 平台一致性与隐私担忧。 受访者评估了与使用人工智能相关的若干潜在风险。 他们评估了所认为的场景中涉及的智能体在多大程度上可能被优化以迎合平台提供商的商业目标而非其个人需求。 回答范围从「完全没有」到「完全如此」。 受访者还评估了他们对个人数据被分享给第三方的担忧，以及对人工智能系统学习或推断其偏好或个人画像中敏感信息的担忧。 两项与隐私相关的评估指标的范围均从「完全不担心」到「极为担心」。

sents.en: Platform alignment and privacy concerns.
sents.zh: 平台一致性与隐私担忧。

sents.en: Respondents evaluated several potential risks associated with AI use.
sents.zh: 受访者评估了与使用人工智能相关的若干潜在风险。

sents.en: They rated the extent to which they believed the AI agent involved in the scenario might be optimized toward the platform provider’s business goals rather than their own personal needs.
sents.zh: 他们评估了所认为的场景中涉及的智能体在多大程度上可能被优化以迎合平台提供商的商业目标而非其个人需求。

sents.en: Responses ranged from Not at all to Entirely .
sents.zh: 回答范围从「完全没有」到「完全如此」。

sents.en: Respondents also rated their concern about personal data being shared with third parties and their concern about the AI system learning or inferring sensitive information about their preferences or personal profile.
sents.zh: 受访者还评估了他们对个人数据被分享给第三方的担忧，以及对人工智能系统学习或推断其偏好或个人画像中敏感信息的担忧。

sents.en: Both privacy-related measures ranged from Not at all concerned to Extremely concerned .
sents.zh: 两项与隐私相关的评估指标的范围均从「完全不担心」到「极为担心」。

paragraphs.en: Reasons for accepting or rejecting automation. Conditional follow-up questions were used to collect respondents’ motivations for their automation preferences. Respondents selecting A lot or The entire amount on the automation-preference measure were asked to identify their reasons for wanting the task automated. Response options included freeing time for higher-value activities, avoiding repetitive or tedious work, improving quality of life, reducing stress or mental burden, handling complicated or difficult activities, and remaining organized during busy periods. Respondents selecting None or A little were instead asked to identify their reasons for not wanting the task automated. Response options included the potential consequences of AI errors, a desire for human judgment or oversight, concerns about personal-data use, discomfort sharing required information, the need for human understanding, empathy, or emotional judgment, the personal nature of the activity, enjoyment of performing the task themselves, and limited perceived benefit from automation. Both branches included an open-ended Other response option. Respondents selecting the midpoint, A moderate amount , received neither of these conditional motivation questions. As the conditional items were designed to capture reasons for relatively strong acceptance or rejection of automation, the midpoint response did not clearly indicate either preference, and assigning either set of reasons could have forced respondents into a position they had not expressed.
paragraphs.zh: 接受或拒绝自动化的原因。 采用条件式追问来收集受访者对自动化偏好背后的动机。 在自动化偏好测量中选择“很大程度”或“全部”的受访者，被要求说明他们希望该任务被自动化的原因。 备选原因包括：为更高价值的活动腾出时间、避免重复或繁琐的工作、改善生活质量、减轻压力或心理负担、应对复杂或困难的活动，以及在忙碌时期保持井然有序。 选择“没有”或“很少”的受访者则被要求说明他们不希望该任务被自动化的原因。 备选原因包括：AI 出错可能带来的后果、希望由人类进行判断或监督、对个人数据使用的担忧、不愿分享所需信息、需要人类的理解、共情或情感判断、该活动的私人性质、享受自己亲自完成该任务，以及认为自动化的收益有限。 两个分支均包含开放式的“其他”选项。 选择中间值“中等程度”的受访者不会收到这两个条件式动机问题。 由于这些条件式题目旨在捕捉对自动化相对强烈的接受或拒绝的原因，而中间值回答并未明确表达任何一种偏好，若强行分配其中任何一组原因，都可能迫使受访者站到他们并未表达的立场上。

sents.en: Reasons for accepting or rejecting automation.
sents.zh: 接受或拒绝自动化的原因。

sents.en: Conditional follow-up questions were used to collect respondents’ motivations for their automation preferences.
sents.zh: 采用条件式追问来收集受访者对自动化偏好背后的动机。

sents.en: Respondents selecting A lot or The entire amount on the automation-preference measure were asked to identify their reasons for wanting the task automated.
sents.zh: 在自动化偏好测量中选择“很大程度”或“全部”的受访者，被要求说明他们希望该任务被自动化的原因。

sents.en: Response options included freeing time for higher-value activities, avoiding repetitive or tedious work, improving quality of life, reducing stress or mental burden, handling complicated or difficult activities, and remaining organized during busy periods.
sents.zh: 备选原因包括：为更高价值的活动腾出时间、避免重复或繁琐的工作、改善生活质量、减轻压力或心理负担、应对复杂或困难的活动，以及在忙碌时期保持井然有序。

sents.en: Respondents selecting None or A little were instead asked to identify their reasons for not wanting the task automated.
sents.zh: 选择“没有”或“很少”的受访者则被要求说明他们不希望该任务被自动化的原因。

sents.en: Response options included the potential consequences of AI errors, a desire for human judgment or oversight, concerns about personal-data use, discomfort sharing required information, the need for human understanding, empathy, or emotional judgment, the personal nature of the activity, enjoyment of performing the task themselves, and limited perceived benefit from automation.
sents.zh: 备选原因包括：AI 出错可能带来的后果、希望由人类进行判断或监督、对个人数据使用的担忧、不愿分享所需信息、需要人类的理解、共情或情感判断、该活动的私人性质、享受自己亲自完成该任务，以及认为自动化的收益有限。

sents.en: Both branches included an open-ended Other response option.
sents.zh: 两个分支均包含开放式的“其他”选项。

sents.en: Respondents selecting the midpoint, A moderate amount , received neither of these conditional motivation questions.
sents.zh: 选择中间值“中等程度”的受访者不会收到这两个条件式动机问题。

sents.en: As the conditional items were designed to capture reasons for relatively strong acceptance or rejection of automation, the midpoint response did not clearly indicate either preference, and assigning either set of reasons could have forced respondents into a position they had not expressed.
sents.zh: 由于这些条件式题目旨在捕捉对自动化相对强烈的接受或拒绝的原因，而中间值回答并未明确表达任何一种偏好，若强行分配其中任何一组原因，都可能迫使受访者站到他们并未表达的立场上。

paragraphs.en: Data were collected directly through Qualtrics between April and July 2026. The survey contained 45 possible task scenarios organized across nine domain-level scenario blocks, together with survey metadata, demographic measures, attention checks, and task-specific questions. Data were collected across multiple rounds of survey distribution and exported from Qualtrics as separate CSV files. To combine these survey rounds while preserving the original survey structure, we developed a preprocessing pipeline in Python using the pandas library. The pipeline first detected the character encoding of each survey export by testing multiple commonly used encodings. The individual response datasets were then concatenated into a single response-level dataset. Following aggregation, direct identifiers, including IP addresses, gift-card email addresses, exact recruitment-platform identifiers, and geolocation information, were removed from the datasets before analysis. Respondent identifiers used for statistical analysis were restricted to de-identified internal IDs. Responses were excluded if the survey was incomplete, if the record was a survey preview, or if it was identified as a duplicate. These procedures yielded 289 valid respondents for the analysis. Direct identifiers were removed before analysis, missing values were not imputed, and inferential models were estimated using complete-case observations. The repeated-measures data were then reconstructed from the scenario-specific survey batteries. Each respondent contributed one scenario evaluation from each of the nine substantive task domains, yielding 2,601 respondent-domain-scenario observations.
paragraphs.zh: 数据于2026年4月至7月通过 Qualtrics 直接收集。 该调查包含45个可能的任务情景，分布在九个领域层面的情景模块中，还包括调查元数据、人口统计测量、注意力检查题以及任务相关问题。 数据通过多轮调查分发收集，并从 Qualtrics 以单独的 CSV 文件导出。 为了合并这些调查轮次并保留原始调查结构，我们使用 Python 的 pandas 库开发了一个预处理流程。 该流程首先通过测试多种常用编码来检测每份调查导出文件的字符编码。 随后将各份回答数据集拼接为一个回答层面的单一数据集。 汇总完成后，在分析之前从数据集中删除了直接标识符，包括 IP 地址、礼品卡电子邮箱地址、精确的招募平台标识符以及地理位置信息。 用于统计分析的受访者标识符仅限于去标识化的内部 ID。 如果调查未完成、记录为调查预览或被识别为重复，则排除该回答。 这些处理步骤为分析提供了289名有效受访者。 分析之前删除了直接标识符，缺失值未进行插补，推断模型使用完整案例观测进行估计。 随后从情景相关的调查题组中重构了重复测量数据。 每位受访者在九个实质性任务领域中各贡献一次情景评估，共产生2,601条受访者-领域-情景观测。

paragraphs.en: Statistical Analysis. The primary research question examined which task- and respondent-level characteristics were associated with preferences for greater AI automation. Automation preference was treated as the primary dependent variable and was measured using five ordered response categories: “None,” “A little,” “A moderate amount,” “A lot,” and “The entire amount.” Primary task-level predictors included trust in the AI agent, privacy concern, desired human-AI collaboration, desired AI leadership within a human-AI team, expected financial savings, expected additional expenses, concern about loss of fulfillment, perceived implications for long-term well-being or identity, perceived effects on the well-being of others, and prior task-specific AI use. Trust in human workers and human-AI teams served as secondary descriptive outcomes. Willingness to pay for one-time and monthly AI services was analyzed separately as a secondary economic outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 统计分析。 主要研究问题考察哪些任务层面和受访者层面的特征与更强的AI自动化偏好相关。 自动化偏好被视为主要因变量，采用五个有序的回应类别进行测量：“完全没有”、“有一点”、“中等程度”、“很多”和“全部”。主要的任务层面预测变量包括：对AI智能体的信任、隐私担忧、期望的人机协作方式、期望在人机团队中由AI承担的领导角色、预期的财务节省、预期的额外支出、对成就感丧失的担忧、对长期幸福感或自我认同的潜在影响认知、对他人幸福感的潜在影响认知，以及此前针对该任务的AI使用经验。 对人类工作者和人机团队的信任作为次要的描述性结果变量。 对一次性付费和按月付费AI服务的支付意愿作为次要的经济结果变量单独进行分析。

paragraphs.en: The nine substantive domains were Communication, Creative Work & Content Creation, Household & Home Management, Learning & Skill Development, Medicine & Physical Health, Mental Health & Emotional Support, Personal Finance, Travel, and Workplace & Professional Support. Repeated scenario positions within domains were retained as scenario-within-domain controls rather than as substantive factors. Because one scenario was randomly drawn per domain, each individual task received fewer than 60 observations on average, and the scenarios were selected for coverage of common activities rather than to systematically manipulate task properties. Task-level contrasts would therefore be underpowered and difficult to interpret without a prior characterization of those properties.
paragraphs.zh: 九个实质性领域分别是：沟通、创意工作与内容创作、家务与家庭管理、学习与技能发展、医疗与身体健康、心理健康与情感支持、个人理财、旅行以及职场与职业支持。 同一领域内重复出现的情景位置被保留为「领域内情景」控制项，而非实质性因素。 由于每个领域仅随机抽取一个情景，每项任务平均获得的观测数不足 60，且这些情景的选取是为了覆盖常见活动，而非系统地操控任务属性。 因此，在没有事先刻画这些属性的情况下，任务层面的对比将缺乏统计功效且难以解释。

paragraphs.en: Descriptive analyses. Participant characteristics were summarized using frequencies and percentages. Ordinal task measures were summarized using response distributions, medians and interquartile ranges, with means and standard deviations also reported for descriptive comparison across domains. Automation preference was visualized using percentage distributions across its five response categories as the measure was discrete and ordinal. Trust in an AI agent, a human worker, and a human-AI team was summarized overall and by domain. Privacy concern, collaboration preference, AI leadership preference, anticipated financial consequences, fulfillment concerns, identity relevance, and consequences for others were similarly summarized across domains.
paragraphs.zh: 描述性分析。 使用频数和百分比对参与者特征进行汇总。 顺序任务测量指标通过响应分布、中位数和四分位距进行汇总，同时还报告了均值和标准差，以便在各领域之间进行描述性比较。 由于自动化偏好是离散且顺序的变量，故使用其五个响应类别的百分比分布来进行可视化。 对智能体的信任、对人类工作者的信任以及对人机团队的信任进行了总体和分领域的汇总。 隐私担忧、协作偏好、AI领导偏好、预期的经济后果、满足感担忧、身份相关性以及对他人造成的影响同样按领域进行了汇总。

paragraphs.en: Privacy composite. The two privacy items measured concern about personal data being shared with third parties and concern about the AI learning or inferring sensitive information. These measures were strongly correlated, Spearman ρ = .910 \rho=.910 , and demonstrated high two-item internal consistency, Cronbach’s α = .954 \alpha=.954 . Accordingly, their mean was used as a privacy-concern composite in multivariable analyses. Both individual items were retained for descriptive analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 隐私综合指标。 这两个隐私条目分别测量了对个人数据被共享给第三方的担忧，以及对 AI 学习或推断敏感信息的担忧。 这两项测量高度相关，Spearman ρ = .910 \rho=.910，并表现出较高的两条目内部一致性，Cronbach's α = .954 \alpha=.954。 因此，在多变量分析中使用两者的均值作为隐私担忧综合指标。 两个单独条目均被保留用于描述性分析。

sents.zh: 隐私综合指标。

paragraphs.en: Repeated-measures analysis. Because each participant contributed repeated scenario evaluations, observations were not treated as statistically independent. The primary inferential analysis used generalized estimating equations (GEE) with respondent as the clustering unit, an exchangeable within-respondent working correlation structure, and robust sandwich standard errors. The primary Gaussian GEE treated the five-category automation response as an approximately continuous score from 0 to 4. This specification permitted simultaneous adjustment for the complete set of substantive predictors, respondent covariates, domain effects, and scenario-within-domain effects while accounting for repeated observations from each respondent.
paragraphs.zh: 重复测量分析。 由于每位受访者提供了多个情境评价，观测值未被视为统计上相互独立。 主要推断分析使用广义估计方程（GEE），以受访者作为聚类单元，采用受访者内部可交换的工作相关结构，以及稳健三明治标准误。 主要的高斯 GEE 将五类别的自动化回应视为 0 到 4 的近似连续分数。 这一设定在考虑每位受访者重复观测的同时，允许对所有实质性预测变量、受访者协变量、领域效应以及领域内情境效应进行同时调整。

sents.en: Repeated-measures analysis.
sents.zh: 重复测量分析。

sents.en: Because each participant contributed repeated scenario evaluations, observations were not treated as statistically independent.
sents.zh: 由于每位受访者提供了多个情境评价，观测值未被视为统计上相互独立。

sents.en: The primary inferential analysis used generalized estimating equations (GEE) with respondent as the clustering unit, an exchangeable within-respondent working correlation structure, and robust sandwich standard errors.
sents.zh: 主要推断分析使用广义估计方程（GEE），以受访者作为聚类单元，采用受访者内部可交换的工作相关结构，以及稳健三明治标准误。

sents.en: The primary Gaussian GEE treated the five-category automation response as an approximately continuous score from 0 to 4.
sents.zh: 主要的高斯 GEE 将五类别的自动化回应视为 0 到 4 的近似连续分数。

sents.en: This specification permitted simultaneous adjustment for the complete set of substantive predictors, respondent covariates, domain effects, and scenario-within-domain effects while accounting for repeated observations from each respondent.
sents.zh: 这一设定在考虑每位受访者重复观测的同时，允许对所有实质性预测变量、受访者协变量、领域效应以及领域内情境效应进行同时调整。

paragraphs.en: The primary model included domain fixed effects and scenario-position-within-domain fixed effects. Respondent-level covariates included age group, gender, household income, educational attainment, political orientation, general attitude toward AI, self-reported AI knowledge, familiarity with large language models, and frequency of LLM use. Ordered respondent measures were coded according to their natural ordering. Gender was treated as a categorical covariate. “Prefer not to say” responses were treated as missing for ordinal respondent-level covariates; gender was retained as a categorical covariate, including a “Prefer not to say” category.
paragraphs.zh: 主模型包含领域固定效应以及领域内情境位置固定效应。 受访者层面的协变量包括年龄组、性别、家庭收入、受教育程度、政治倾向、对人工智能的总体态度、自评的人工智能知识、对大语言模型的熟悉程度以及大语言模型的使用频率。 有序的受访者测量指标按其自然顺序进行编码。 性别被视为分类协变量。对于有序受访者层面协变量，“不愿透露”的回答被视为缺失值；性别保留为分类协变量，其中包括“不愿透露”这一类别。

sents.zh: 主模型包含领域固定效应以及领域内情境位置固定效应。

sents.zh: 有序的受访者测量指标按其自然顺序进行编码。

sents.en: Gender was treated as a categorical covariate. “Prefer not to say” responses were treated as missing for ordinal respondent-level covariates; gender was retained as a categorical covariate, including a “Prefer not to say” category.
sents.zh: 性别被视为分类协变量。对于有序受访者层面协变量，“不愿透露”的回答被视为缺失值；性别保留为分类协变量，其中包括“不愿透露”这一类别。

paragraphs.en: Prior task-specific AI use required conditional coding because the AI-use item was asked only when respondents indicated that they had previously performed the task. Respondents who reported that they had never performed a task were coded as having no prior task-specific AI use. Among respondents who had performed the task previously, explicit Yes/No responses to prior AI use were coded directly.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的任务专用 AI 使用需要条件编码，因为只有在受访者表示他们之前执行过该任务时，才会询问该 AI 使用项目。 报告从未执行过某任务的受访者被编码为无先前的任务专用 AI 使用。 在之前执行过该任务的受访者中，对先前 AI 使用的明确的「是/否」回答被直接编码。

sents.en: Prior task-specific AI use required conditional coding because the AI-use item was asked only when respondents indicated that they had previously performed the task.

paragraphs.en: Ordinal sensitivity analysis. Because automation preference was measured on an ordinal scale, we estimated a cumulative ordinal GEE as a robustness analysis. To improve model stability, this sensitivity model used a more parsimonious specification that retained respondent clustering, the substantive task-level predictors, and domain fixed effects, but omitted respondent-level covariates and scenario-within-domain controls. Because all variables included in this specification were complete, the ordinal model retained all 2,601 observations from 289 respondents. Agreement in the direction and statistical significance of the central predictors across the Gaussian and ordinal specifications was used to assess robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 序数敏感性分析。 由于自动化偏好是以序数尺度测量的，我们估计了一个累积序数GEE作为稳健性分析。 为提高模型稳定性，该敏感性模型采用了更简约的设定，保留了受访者聚类、实质性的任务层面预测变量以及领域固定效应，但省略了受访者层面协变量和领域内情境控制变量。 由于该设定中包含的所有变量都是完整的，序数模型保留了来自289名受访者的全部2,601个观测值。 通过比较高斯设定与序数设定中核心预测变量在方向和统计显著性上的一致性来评估稳健性。

paragraphs.en: Willingness-to-pay analysis. Willingness-to-pay responses were parsed as nonnegative monetary values. Nonnumeric responses were treated as missing, and negative values were excluded. Because WTP contained substantial numbers of zero responses and pronounced right skew, monetary outcomes were summarized using the median, interquartile range, upper percentiles, percentage reporting zero, and maximum.
paragraphs.zh: 支付意愿分析。 支付意愿的回答被解析为非负的货币数值。 非数值的回答被视为缺失，负值被排除。 由于支付意愿中包含大量零值回答且呈现明显的右偏分布，货币结果使用中位数、四分位距、高位百分位数、报告零值的百分比以及最大值进行汇总。

sents.en: Willingness-to-pay analysis.
sents.zh: 支付意愿分析。

sents.en: Willingness-to-pay responses were parsed as nonnegative monetary values.
sents.zh: 支付意愿的回答被解析为非负的货币数值。

sents.en: Nonnumeric responses were treated as missing, and negative values were excluded.
sents.zh: 非数值的回答被视为缺失，负值被排除。

paragraphs.en: WTP was analyzed using a two-part repeated-measures approach. First, logistic GEE modeled whether WTP was greater than zero. Second, among positive responses, Gaussian GEE modeled the natural logarithm of the amount reported. Both models clustered observations by respondent and included domain and scenario-within-domain controls.
paragraphs.zh: 使用两部分重复测量方法对支付意愿（WTP）进行分析。 首先，采用逻辑GEE模型对支付意愿是否大于零进行建模。 其次，在正向回答中，采用高斯GEE模型对所报告金额的自然对数进行建模。 两个模型均按受访者对观测值进行聚类，并纳入领域以及领域内情景的控制变量。

sents.en: WTP was analyzed using a two-part repeated-measures approach.
sents.zh: 使用两部分重复测量方法对支付意愿（WTP）进行分析。

sents.en: First, logistic GEE modeled whether WTP was greater than zero.
sents.zh: 首先，采用逻辑GEE模型对支付意愿是否大于零进行建模。

sents.en: Second, among positive responses, Gaussian GEE modeled the natural logarithm of the amount reported.
sents.zh: 其次，在正向回答中，采用高斯GEE模型对所报告金额的自然对数进行建模。

sents.en: Both models clustered observations by respondent and included domain and scenario-within-domain controls.
sents.zh: 两个模型均按受访者对观测值进行聚类，并纳入领域以及领域内情景的控制变量。

paragraphs.en: Secondary analyses and statistical inference. Participant-level Spearman correlations among major attitudinal constructs were calculated as secondary descriptive analyses after averaging each construct across each respondent’s evaluated scenarios. Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction was applied to families of secondary WTP tests and exploratory correlations. Primary-model effects were evaluated using two-sided tests with α = .05 \alpha=.05 and 95% confidence intervals.
paragraphs.zh: 二次分析与统计推断。 在将每个构念在各受访者所评估的场景上取平均后，计算主要态度构念之间参与者层面的Spearman相关，作为二次描述性分析。 对二次WTP检验族和探索性相关分析应用Benjamini-Hochberg错误发现率校正。 主要模型的效应采用双侧检验进行评估，显著性水平为α = .05 \alpha=.05，并给出95%置信区间。

sents.en: Secondary analyses and statistical inference.
sents.zh: 二次分析与统计推断。

sents.en: Participant-level Spearman correlations among major attitudinal constructs were calculated as secondary descriptive analyses after averaging each construct across each respondent’s evaluated scenarios.
sents.zh: 在将每个构念在各受访者所评估的场景上取平均后，计算主要态度构念之间参与者层面的Spearman相关，作为二次描述性分析。

sents.en: Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction was applied to families of secondary WTP tests and exploratory correlations.
sents.zh: 对二次WTP检验族和探索性相关分析应用Benjamini-Hochberg错误发现率校正。

sents.en: Primary-model effects were evaluated using two-sided tests with α = .05 \alpha=.05 and 95% confidence intervals.
sents.zh: 主要模型的效应采用双侧检验进行评估，显著性水平为α = .05 \alpha=.05，并给出95%置信区间。

paragraphs.en: No predictor-by-domain or respondent-characteristic interaction terms were included in the primary analysis. The present models therefore estimate average associations across domains while controlling for domain-level mean differences; they do not test whether a predictor has a statistically different slope in one domain than another. Such interactions would be more appropriately treated as targeted follow-up analyses rather than adding a large number of exploratory terms to the primary model.
paragraphs.zh: 主要分析中未纳入预测变量与领域的交互项或受访者特征的交互项。 因此，本模型估计的是各领域间的平均关联，同时控制了领域层面的均值差异；模型并不检验某一预测变量在一个领域中的斜率是否与另一个领域存在统计学差异。 此类交互作用更适合作为有针对性的后续分析来处理，而非在主要模型中加入大量探索性交互项。

paragraphs.en: To complement the survey measures, we analyzed respondents’ open-ended descriptions of how they would want an AI system to perform a task. Because this question was shown only when respondents indicated at least some willingness to involve AI, the analysis characterizes preferred forms of AI delegation among respondents open to some degree of automation. One member of the research team first read a subset of responses to develop an initial coding scheme, from which eight codes emerged inductively: Autonomous Execution, Assistive/Collaborative Support, Human Oversight & Control, Personalization & Context Awareness, Proactive/Continuous Assistance, Transparency & Grounding, Reliability/Accuracy & Safety, and Output/Interaction Specification. The same coder then applied this scheme to the full corpus, assigning any number of codes to each response so that participants describing several desired properties were captured under multiple codes. Codes were descriptive, characterizing the form of AI involvement participants requested. We therefore report code prevalence at both the domain and task level, with task-level percentages treated as hypothesis-generating given the smaller number of responses per task. Definitions and representative examples for each code are provided in Table 1 . The coding process was collaborative, with ambiguous cases discussed among the research team until consensus was reached.
paragraphs.zh: 为补充调查测量，我们分析了受访者对希望 AI 系统如何执行任务的开放式描述。 由于该问题仅在受访者表示至少有一定意愿让 AI 参与时才显示，本分析刻画的是对某种程度自动化持开放态度的受访者所偏好的 AI 委托形式。 研究团队的一名成员首先阅读了部分回复以建立初始编码方案，由此归纳出八个编码：自主执行、辅助/协作支持、人类监督与控制、个性化与情境感知、主动/持续协助、透明性与依据、可靠性/准确性与安全，以及输出/交互规格。 随后同一编码者将该方案应用于全部语料，为每条回复赋予任意数量的编码，从而对描述了多项期望属性的参与者以多个编码加以捕捉。 这些编码是描述性的，用于刻画参与者所要求的 AI 参与形式。 因此我们在领域和任务两个层面报告编码的出现率，鉴于每个任务的回复数量较少，任务层面的百分比被视为产生假设性质的结论。 各编码的定义与代表性示例见表 1 。 编码过程是协作性的，对于含义模糊的情况，研究团队会进行讨论直至达成共识。

paragraphs.en: After applying the data-cleaning and exclusion criteria, the analytic sample contained 289 unique respondents. Each respondent contributed evaluations from nine substantive domains, producing 2,601 respondent-domain-scenario observations.
paragraphs.zh: 在应用数据清洗和剔除标准后，分析样本包含289名唯一受访者。 每位受访者提供了来自九个实质性领域的评估，共产生2,601条受访者-领域-情景观测记录。

sents.en: Each respondent contributed evaluations from nine substantive domains, producing 2,601 respondent-domain-scenario observations.

paragraphs.en: The sample was 57.8% male ( n = 167 n=167 ), 39.4% female ( n = 114 n=114 ), and 1.7% non-binary or third gender ( n = 5 n=5 ); three respondents selected “Prefer not to say” for gender. Participants were predominantly younger and middle-aged: 29.1% were 18-24 years old, 23.2% were 25-34, 24.6% were 35-44, and 13.5% were 45-54. Bachelor’s degrees were reported by 31.1% of respondents, 17.3% reported a graduate or professional degree, and 24.2% reported some college without a degree.

paragraphs.en: Participants generally reported substantial familiarity with AI technologies. A positive or very positive overall attitude toward AI was reported by 61.9% of respondents. Approximately 88.2% described themselves as moderately, very, or extremely knowledgeable about AI. LLM familiarity was also high: 47.1% reported being very familiar and 17.6% extremely familiar with systems such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. LLM use was frequent, with 29.1% reporting daily use and 24.9% reporting use multiple times per day.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者普遍表示对人工智能技术相当熟悉。 61.9% 的受访者表示对人工智能持正面或非常正面的总体态度。 约 88.2% 的受访者自认为对人工智能具备中等、较高或非常高的了解程度。 对大语言模型的熟悉度也很高：47.1% 的受访者表示非常熟悉，17.6% 表示极其熟悉 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Gemini 等系统。 大语言模型的使用频率较高，29.1% 的受访者表示每天使用，24.9% 表示每天使用多次。

paragraphs.en: Automation preferences varied substantially across domains (Figure 3 ). Travel had the highest mean automation preference ( M = 2.40 M=2.40 ), followed closely by Communication ( M = 2.37 M=2.37 ). Learning & Skill Development had a mean of 2.26 2.26 , then followed by Household & Home Management ( M = 2.09 M=2.09 ) and Personal Finance ( M = 2.07 M=2.07 ). Preferences were lower for Workplace & Professional Support ( M = 1.96 M=1.96 ), Medicine & Physical Health ( M = 1.95 M=1.95 ), Creative Work & Content Creation ( M = 1.93 M=1.93 ), and Mental Health & Emotional Support ( M = 1.51 M=1.51 ).
paragraphs.zh: 自动化偏好在各领域之间存在显著差异（图 3）。 旅行领域的平均自动化偏好最高（M = 2.40），其次是沟通领域（M = 2.37）。 学习与技能发展的均值为 2.26，其后依次是家务与家庭管理（M = 2.09）和个人理财（M = 2.07）。 职场与专业支持（M = 1.96）、医学与身体健康（M = 1.95）、创意工作与内容创作（M = 1.93）以及心理健康与情感支持（M = 1.51）的偏好较低。

paragraphs.en: Automation preference was available for all 2,601 scenario observations and was coded on a five-point scale from 0 ( None ) to 4 ( The entire amount ). Overall, 16.0% of responses selected None , 17.7% selected A little , 25.6% selected A moderate amount , 25.8% selected A lot , and 15.0% selected The entire amount . Thus, responses were concentrated around moderate to high levels of automation, although complete delegation remained less common.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化偏好数据覆盖全部2,601个情景观测，并采用五点量表编码，从0（无）到4（全部）。 总体而言，16.0%的回答选择了“无”，17.7%选择了“一点”，25.6%选择了“适量”，25.8%选择了“很多”，15.0%选择了“全部”。 因此，回答集中在中等到高等程度的自动化水平上，尽管完全委托的情况仍较为少见。

paragraphs.en: The domain-level distributions show that this pattern was not uniform. The strongest preference for complete automation was observed in Communication, where 25.3% of responses selected The entire amount , followed by Travel at 21.1% and Personal Finance at 17.0%. By contrast, complete automation was selected in 10.4% of Medicine & Physical Health responses, 11.1% of Workplace & Professional Support responses, and 10.0% of Mental Health & Emotional Support responses.
paragraphs.zh: 领域层面的分布表明，这一模式并非一致。 对完全自动化的最强偏好出现在通信领域，其中 25.3% 的回答选择了「全部」，其次是旅行领域的 21.1% 和个人理财领域的 17.0%。 相比之下，完全自动化在医学与身体健康类回答中的选择比例为 10.4%，在职场与专业支持类回答中为 11.1%，在心理健康与情感支持类回答中为 10.0%。

sents.en: The domain-level distributions show that this pattern was not uniform.
sents.zh: 领域层面的分布表明，这一模式并非一致。

paragraphs.en: Preferences for no automation also varied substantially across domains. None was selected most frequently for Mental Health & Emotional Support (31.8%), followed by Personal Finance (18.7%) and Creative Work & Content Creation (18.3%). It was least frequent for Learning & Skill Development (9.7%) and Travel (10.4%). These distributions suggest that participants distinguished sharply between domains when deciding how much responsibility to hand over to AI.
paragraphs.zh: 对不使用自动化的偏好在不同领域间也存在显著差异。 在「心理健康与情感支持」领域选择「无自动化」的比例最高（31.8%），其次是「个人理财」（18.7%）和「创意工作与内容创作」（18.3%）。 「学习与技能发展」（9.7%）和「旅行」（10.4%）领域的这一比例最低。 这些分布表明，参与者在决定将多少责任交给 AI 时，对不同领域做出了明确的区分。

paragraphs.en: Trust and attitudes toward AI involvement differed across domains (Figure 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 不同领域中，对 AI 参与的信任和态度存在差异（图 4）。

paragraphs.en: Differences in automation preference were accompanied by differences in trust and desired human involvement (Figure 4 ). Across all scenario evaluations, mean trust was higher for human workers ( M = 3.41 M=3.41 ) and human-AI teams ( M = 3.43 M=3.43 ) than for AI agents alone ( M = 3.02 M=3.02 ). Trust in AI was highest in Learning & Skill Development ( M = 3.33 M=3.33 ) and Travel ( M = 3.32 M=3.32 ), and lowest in Mental Health & Emotional Support ( M = 2.49 M=2.49 ).
paragraphs.zh: 自动化偏好的差异伴随着信任度和期望的人类参与程度的差异（图4）。 在所有场景评估中，人类工作者（M = 3.41）和人机团队（M = 3.43）的平均信任度均高于单独使用AI智能体（M = 3.02）。 对AI智能体的信任度在「学习与技能发展」（M = 3.33）和「旅行」（M = 3.32）场景中最高，在「心理健康与情感支持」（M = 2.49）场景中最低。

sents.en: Differences in automation preference were accompanied by differences in trust and desired human involvement (Figure 4 ).
sents.zh: 自动化偏好的差异伴随着信任度和期望的人类参与程度的差异（图4）。

sents.en: Across all scenario evaluations, mean trust was higher for human workers ( M = 3.41 M=3.41 ) and human-AI teams ( M = 3.43 M=3.43 ) than for AI agents alone ( M = 3.02 M=3.02 ).
sents.zh: 在所有场景评估中，人类工作者（M = 3.41）和人机团队（M = 3.43）的平均信任度均高于单独使用AI智能体（M = 3.02）。

sents.zh: 对AI智能体的信任度在「学习与技能发展」（M = 3.33）和「旅行」（M = 3.32）场景中最高，在「心理健康与情感支持」（M = 2.49）场景中最低。

paragraphs.en: Privacy concerns followed a different domain pattern. The overall mean was 2.85 2.85 on the five-point scale. Concern was greatest in Mental Health & Emotional Support ( M = 3.32 M=3.32 ) and Personal Finance ( M = 3.32 M=3.32 ), followed by Medicine & Physical Health ( M = 3.16 M=3.16 ) and Workplace & Professional Support ( M = 3.09 M=3.09 ). It was lowest in Learning & Skill Development ( M = 2.34 M=2.34 ) and Creative Work & Content Creation ( M = 2.46 M=2.46 ). The two privacy items were highly correlated, ρ = .910 \rho=.910 , and had high internal consistency, α = .954 \alpha=.954 .
paragraphs.zh: 隐私担忧呈现出不同的领域模式。 五点量表上的总体均值为 2.85 2.85。 在心理健康与情感支持领域（ M = 3.32 M=3.32 ）和个人理财领域（ M = 3.32 M=3.32 ）担忧程度最高，其次是医学与身体健康领域（ M = 3.16 M=3.16 ）和职场与专业支持领域（ M = 3.09 M=3.09 ）。 在学习与技能发展领域（ M = 2.34 M=2.34 ）和创意工作与内容创作领域（ M = 2.46 M=2.46 ）担忧程度最低。 两个隐私题项高度相关，ρ = .910 \rho=.910 ，且具有较高的内部一致性，α = .954 \alpha=.954 。
