sents.zh: 在心理健康与情感支持领域（ M = 3.32 M=3.32 ）和个人理财领域（ M = 3.32 M=3.32 ）担忧程度最高，其次是医学与身体健康领域（ M = 3.16 M=3.16 ）和职场与专业支持领域（ M = 3.09 M=3.09 ）。

paragraphs.en: Participants also tended to favor continued human involvement. Responses reported a mean collaboration requirement of 3.24 3.24 overall. Desired collaboration was greatest for Mental Health & Emotional Support ( M = 3.54 M=3.54 ) and was also relatively high for Learning & Skill Development, Medicine & Physical Health, and Creative Work & Content Creation (all approximately M = 3.37 M=3.37 ). Desired AI leadership was lower overall ( M = 2.65 M=2.65 ). Participants could therefore favor substantial AI involvement while still preferring that responsibility be shared with, or remain partly under the control of, a human.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者也倾向于支持人类继续参与其中。 回答显示整体平均协作需求为 3.24 3.24。 期望协作程度最高的是心理健康与情感支持（M = 3.54 M=3.54），学习与技能发展、医学与身体健康以及创意工作与内容创作方面也相对较高（均约为 M = 3.37 M=3.37）。 期望由 AI 主导的程度整体较低（M = 2.65 M=2.65）。 因此，参与者可能支持大量的 AI 参与，同时仍倾向于让责任与人类分担，或部分保留在人类的控制之下。

paragraphs.en: The fully adjusted Gaussian GEE included 2,366 complete scenario observations from 263 respondents. The model accounted for repeated observations within respondents and adjusted simultaneously for substantive task characteristics, respondent demographics and AI experience, domain, and scenario position within domain.
paragraphs.zh: 完全调整后的高斯广义估计方程（GEE）纳入了来自263名受访者的2,366个完整情景观测值。 该模型考虑了受访者内部的重复观测，并同时对实质性任务特征、受访者人口统计学特征与AI经验、领域以及情景在领域内的位置进行了调整。

sents.en: The fully adjusted Gaussian GEE included 2,366 complete scenario observations from 263 respondents.
sents.zh: 完全调整后的高斯广义估计方程（GEE）纳入了来自263名受访者的2,366个完整情景观测值。

sents.en: The model accounted for repeated observations within respondents and adjusted simultaneously for substantive task characteristics, respondent demographics and AI experience, domain, and scenario position within domain.
sents.zh: 该模型考虑了受访者内部的重复观测，并同时对实质性任务特征、受访者人口统计学特征与AI经验、领域以及情景在领域内的位置进行了调整。

paragraphs.en: Trust in the AI agent was strongly and positively associated with automation preference, b = 0.473 b=0.473 , S ​ E = 0.027 SE=0.027 , 95% CI [ 0.420 , 0.526 ] [0.420,0.526] , p < .001 p<.001 . Thus, a one-point increase in AI trust was associated with an approximately 0.47-point increase in automation preference on the five-point automation scale, holding the remaining modeled factors constant.
paragraphs.zh: 对AI智能体的信任与自动化偏好呈强正相关，b = 0.473，SE = 0.027，95% CI [0.420, 0.526]，p < .001。 因此，在控制其他建模因素不变的情况下，AI信任度每提高1分，五点自动化量表上的自动化偏好约提高0.47分。

sents.en: Trust in the AI agent was strongly and positively associated with automation preference, b = 0.473 b=0.473 , S ​ E = 0.027 SE=0.027 , 95% CI [ 0.420 , 0.526 ] [0.420,0.526] , p < .001 p<.001 .
sents.zh: 对AI智能体的信任与自动化偏好呈强正相关，b = 0.473，SE = 0.027，95% CI [0.420, 0.526]，p < .001。

sents.en: Thus, a one-point increase in AI trust was associated with an approximately 0.47-point increase in automation preference on the five-point automation scale, holding the remaining modeled factors constant.
sents.zh: 因此，在控制其他建模因素不变的情况下，AI信任度每提高1分，五点自动化量表上的自动化偏好约提高0.47分。

paragraphs.en: Desired AI leadership was also positively associated with automation preference, b = 0.200 b=0.200 , S ​ E = 0.031 SE=0.031 , 95% CI [ 0.140 , 0.260 ] [0.140,0.260] , p < .001 p<.001 . Greater expected financial savings was associated with greater automation preference as well, b = 0.074 b=0.074 , S ​ E = 0.020 SE=0.020 , 95% CI [ 0.034 , 0.113 ] [0.034,0.113] , p < .001 p<.001 .
paragraphs.zh: 期望的AI领导力也与自动化偏好呈正相关，b = 0.200，SE = 0.031，95% CI [0.140, 0.260]，p < .001。 更高的预期财务节省也与更高的自动化偏好相关，b = 0.074，SE = 0.020，95% CI [0.034, 0.113]，p < .001。

sents.en: Desired AI leadership was also positively associated with automation preference, b = 0.200 b=0.200 , S ​ E = 0.031 SE=0.031 , 95% CI [ 0.140 , 0.260 ] [0.140,0.260] , p < .001 p<.001 .
Greater expected financial savings was associated with greater automation preference as well, b = 0.074 b=0.074 , S ​ E = 0.020 SE=0.020 , 95% CI [ 0.034 , 0.113 ] [0.034,0.113] , p < .001 p<.001 .
sents.zh: 更高的预期财务节省也与更高的自动化偏好相关，b = 0.074，SE = 0.020，95% CI [0.034, 0.113]，p < .001。

paragraphs.en: Prior task-specific AI use was also positively associated with automation preference, b = 0.164 b=0.164 , S ​ E = 0.045 SE=0.045 , 95% CI [ 0.075 , 0.253 ] [0.075,0.253] , p < .001 p<.001 . Respondents who had previously used AI for a task therefore tended to prefer greater automation of that task after adjustment for the other modeled factors.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的任务特定AI使用也与自动化偏好呈正相关，b = 0.164，SE = 0.045，95% CI [0.075, 0.253]，p < .001。 因此，在调整其他建模因素后，先前曾将AI用于某项任务的受访者往往更倾向于对该任务进行更高程度的自动化。

sents.en: Prior task-specific AI use was also positively associated with automation preference, b = 0.164 b=0.164 , S ​ E = 0.045 SE=0.045 , 95% CI [ 0.075 , 0.253 ] [0.075,0.253] , p < .001 p<.001 .
sents.zh: 先前的任务特定AI使用也与自动化偏好呈正相关，b = 0.164，SE = 0.045，95% CI [0.075, 0.253]，p < .001。

sents.en: Respondents who had previously used AI for a task therefore tended to prefer greater automation of that task after adjustment for the other modeled factors.

paragraphs.en: Concern that AI automation would make life less exciting or fulfilling was negatively associated with automation preference, b = − 0.077 b=-0.077 , S ​ E = 0.022 SE=0.022 , 95% CI [ − 0.120 , − 0.034 ] [-0.120,-0.034] , p < .001 p<.001 . paragraphs.en: The model points to a relatively focused set of factors associated with delegation preferences. Participants favored greater automation when they trusted the AI more, wanted it to take a stronger leadership role, had previously used AI for the same task, or expected financial savings. Concern about losing fulfillment moved preferences in the opposite direction. Privacy and desired collaboration varied meaningfully across domains, but neither explained additional variation in automation preference once the other factors in the model were taken into account.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型指向一组与委派偏好相关的、相对集中的因素。 当参与者更信任AI、希望它承担更强的领导角色、以前曾将AI用于同一任务，或预期会节省开支时，他们更倾向于更高程度的自动化。 对失去成就感的担忧则使偏好朝相反方向移动。 隐私和期望的协作方式在不同领域之间存在显著差异，但一旦考虑到模型中的其他因素，两者都无法解释自动化偏好中的额外变异。

paragraphs.en: The cumulative ordinal GEE sensitivity analysis included all 2,601 observations from 289 respondents because its more parsimonious specification omitted respondent-level covariates containing missing values. The model retained respondent clustering, domain fixed effects, and all substantive task-level predictors, and produced the same substantive pattern for the central predictors.
paragraphs.zh: 累积序数GEE敏感性分析纳入了来自289名受访者的全部2,601个观测值，因为其更为简约的模型设定省略了含有缺失值的受访者层面协变量。 该模型保留了受访者聚类、领域固定效应以及所有实质性任务层面预测变量，并对核心预测变量得出了相同的实质性结果模式。

paragraphs.en: Higher trust in AI was associated with substantially greater odds of selecting a higher automation category, O ​ R = 3.03 OR=3.03 , 95% CI [ 2.52 , 3.65 ] [2.52,3.65] , p < .001 p<.001 . Desired AI leadership was similarly associated with greater automation, O ​ R = 1.64 OR=1.64 , 95% CI [ 1.41 , 1.91 ] [1.41,1.91] , p < .001 p<.001 , as was expected financial savings, O ​ R = 1.36 OR=1.36 , 95% CI [ 1.19 , 1.55 ] [1.19,1.55] , p < .001 p<.001 .

paragraphs.en: As in the primary model, privacy concern was not independently associated with automation preference ( O ​ R = 0.95 OR=0.95 , 95% CI [ 0.87 , 1.05 ] [0.87,1.05] , p = .344 p=.344 ), nor was desired collaboration ( O ​ R = 1.00 OR=1.00 , 95% CI [ 0.91 , 1.11 ] [0.91,1.11] , p = .988 p=.988 ). Expected expenses, identity impact, and effects on others’ well-being were likewise not significant in the ordinal sensitivity model. The consistency across specifications suggests that the main pattern of results was not sensitive to treating automation preference as approximately continuous in the primary analysis.

paragraphs.en: Willingness to pay (WTP) was generally modest, although responses were highly right-skewed and varied across domains (Figure 5 ). There were 2,429 usable one-time WTP responses. The median one-time WTP was $10.00, with an interquartile range of $0-$30.00. Approximately 28.8% of responses were $0. The upper tail was considerably larger: the 95th percentile was $200 and the 99th percentile was approximately $736, while the maximum reported value was $200,000.
paragraphs.zh: 支付意愿（WTP）总体上较为有限，尽管回答呈高度右偏分布，且在不同领域之间存在差异（图 5）。 共有 2,429 份有效的一次性支付意愿回答。 一次性支付意愿的中位数为 10.00 美元，四分位距为 0 至 30.00 美元。 约 28.8% 的回答为 0 美元。 上尾明显更大：第 95 百分位为 200 美元，第 99 百分位约为 736 美元，而报告的最大值为 200,000 美元。

Median one-time WTP was $6.50 for Communication and $5 for both Mental Health & Emotional Support and Travel. Mental Health & Emotional Support also had the highest share of zero one-time WTP responses, 43.9%.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者愿意支付的金额也因领域而异。 一次性支付意愿的中位数在职场与专业支持领域最高，为15美元；创意工作与内容创作、家庭与家务管理、学习与技能发展、医疗与身体健康以及个人理财领域均为10美元。 沟通领域的一次性支付意愿中位数为6.50美元，心理健康与情感支持以及旅行领域均为5美元。 心理健康与情感支持领域的零一次性支付意愿回应占比也最高，为43.9%。

paragraphs.en: For one-time WTP, 2,429 complete observations were available for the positive-versus-zero model. Greater automation preference was associated with greater odds of being willing to pay a positive amount, O ​ R = 1.43 OR=1.43 , p < .001 p<.001 , FDR-adjusted p < .001 p<.001 . Greater trust in AI was also associated with greater odds of positive WTP, O ​ R = 1.45 OR=1.45 , p < .001 p<.001 , FDR-adjusted p < .001 p<.001 , as was greater expected savings, O ​ R = 1.41 OR=1.41 , p < .001 p<.001 , FDR-adjusted p < .001 p<.001 . Privacy concern and expected additional expenses were not significantly associated with the likelihood of positive one-time WTP after correction.
paragraphs.zh: 对于一次性支付意愿，正向对比零值模型共有2,429个完整观测值。 对自动化程度更高的偏好与愿意支付正数金额的几率更高相关，OR=1.43，p<.001，FDR校正后p<.001。 对AI的信任度更高也与正数支付意愿的几率更高相关，OR=1.45，p<.001，FDR校正后p<.001；预期节省金额更高同样如此，OR=1.41，p<.001，FDR校正后p<.001。 经过校正后，隐私担忧和预期额外支出与正数一次性支付意愿的可能性无显著关联。

paragraphs.en: The final corpus contained 2,216 non-empty responses, of which 2,156 were substantively codable. Multiple codes could be applied to each response when participants described more than one desired form of AI involvement. The dominant pattern was that respondents rarely framed AI involvement as a simple choice between full automation and human performance. Figure 6 presents the prevalence of each code across the nine task domains, revealing substantial variation in the forms of AI involvement participants described. Assistive/Collaborative Support appeared in 66.2% of codable responses and Autonomous Execution in 48.0%, with both appearing together in 25.6%. Many responses described AI performing substantial portions of a task while leaving consequential decisions or final approval to the user. For example, one participant requested that an AI act “autonomously, but I want to approve and review major changes” (P292, Condition Adjustment). Similarly, for appointment scheduling, a participant wanted the AI to find and coordinate available times but to “ask for my approval before confirming any appointment” (P262). These responses illustrate a form of bounded autonomy in which task execution is delegated while judgment or final commitment remains under human control.
paragraphs.zh: 最终语料库包含 2,216 条非空回复，其中 2,156 条可进行实质性编码。 当参与者描述了不止一种期望的 AI 参与形式时，每条回复可应用多个编码。 主导模式是，受访者很少将 AI 参与 framed 成完全自动化与人工执行之间的简单选择。 图 6 展示了各编码在九个任务领域中的出现频率，揭示了参与者所描述的 AI 参与形式存在显著差异。 辅助/协作支持出现在 66.2% 的可编码回复中，自主执行出现在 48.0% 的回复中，两者同时出现的情况占 25.6%。 许多回复描述了 AI 执行任务的大部分内容，同时将关键决策或最终批准留给用户。 例如，一位参与者要求 AI「自主行动，但我希望对重大变更进行批准和审查」（P292，条件调整）。 类似地，在预约安排方面，一位参与者希望 AI 查找并协调可用时间，但要「在确认任何预约之前征求我的批准」（P262）。 这些回复展示了一种有界自主的形式，即任务执行被委托出去，而判断或最终承诺仍由人类掌控。

paragraphs.en: Desired configurations also varied meaningfully across tasks. Emotionally sensitive activities were framed primarily as collaborative as Assistive/Collaborative Support appeared in 91.9% of Emotional Distress Support responses and 90.0% of Coping Strategies responses. One participant described wanting AI to be “a sounding board and provide fresh ways to look at problems” ( Emotional Distress Support ). By contrast, more procedural tasks more often elicited direct delegation, with Autonomous Execution appearing in 76.8% of Appointment Scheduling and 70.4% of Translation responses. Such contrasts suggest that users distinguish not simply how much AI should do, but which components of a task are appropriate to delegate. Participants also frequently specified conditions surrounding delegation. Personalization and proactive assistance were particularly salient for activities that depend on changing user context. For language learning, one participant wanted an AI to “adapt to [their] level and track [their] progress”, while another wanted commute assistance to proactively incorporate “real-time traffic, weather, and [their] schedule”. Other responses emphasized accountability. In research tasks, participants requested citations, source links, and traceability; one participant asked for “page numbers and a hyperlink to exactly where in a PDF or a document it is drawing it from” ( Research & Academic Assistant ). For action-taking agents, transparency sometimes meant proof of execution rather than an agent’s explanation of its results. For instance, the same participant wanted a subscription agent to cancel a service and simply “show [them] proof that it did.”
paragraphs.zh: 期望的配置在不同任务间也存在显著差异。 情绪敏感类活动主要被框定为协作式，因为辅助/协作支持出现在 91.9% 的情绪困扰支持回复和 90.0% 的应对策略回复中。 一位参与者表示希望人工智能成为「一个出谋划策的对象，并提供看待问题的新视角」（情绪困扰支持）。 相比之下，更偏程序性的任务更常引发直接委托，自主执行出现在 76.8% 的预约安排回复和 70.4% 的翻译回复中。 这种对比表明，用户区分的不仅仅是人工智能应该做多少，而是任务中哪些组成部分适合委托出去。 参与者们还经常为委托设定附带条件。 个性化与主动辅助在那些依赖于不断变化的用户情境的活动中尤为突出。 在语言学习方面，一位参与者希望人工智能能「适应[他们的]水平并跟踪[他们的]进度」，而另一位参与者则希望通勤辅助能主动纳入「实时交通、天气以及[他们的]日程安排」。 其他回复则强调了可问责性。 在研究类任务中，参与者要求提供引用、来源链接和可追溯性；一位参与者要求提供「页码以及一个超链接，能精确指向其所引用内容在 PDF 或文档中的位置」（研究与学术助手）。 对于执行操作的智能体而言，透明有时意味着执行证明，而不是智能体对其结果的解释。 例如，同一位参与者希望一个订阅管理智能体取消某项服务，并简单地「向[他们]出示它已完成操作的证明」。

paragraphs.en: Across the quantitative and qualitative analyses, preferences for AI delegation varied substantially across tasks and domains. Participants were generally more willing to automate activities such as travel and communication and less willing to automate mental-health and emotional-support tasks. In the adjusted models, greater trust in the AI agent, stronger preference for AI leadership, prior task-specific AI use, and anticipated financial savings were consistently associated with greater automation preference. Concern that automation would reduce personal fulfillment was associated with lower automation preference. These relationships were consistent across the Gaussian and ordinal model specifications. Privacy concern and desired human-AI collaboration varied across domains but were not independently associated with automation preference after adjustment.
paragraphs.zh: 在定量和定性分析中，对AI委托的偏好在不同任务和领域间存在显著差异。 参与者通常更愿意将旅行和交流等活动自动化，而对心理健康和情感支持类任务的自动化意愿较低。 在调整后的模型中，对AI智能体更高的信任度、更强的AI领导偏好、既往的任务特定AI使用经历以及预期的经济节省，均与更高的自动化偏好持续相关。 担心自动化会降低个人成就感则与较低的自动化偏好相关。 这些关系在高斯模型和有序模型两种设定中均保持一致。 隐私担忧以及期望的人机协作在不同领域间有所差异，但在调整后并未显示与自动化偏好存在独立关联。

paragraphs.en: The open-ended responses add detail to these patterns by showing how participants wanted delegation to work in practice. Many respondents combined substantial AI execution with continued human involvement, particularly through review, approval, or control over consequential decisions. The preferred arrangement also depended on the task. Emotionally sensitive activities elicited stronger preferences for collaborative support, whereas procedural activities more often elicited requests for autonomous execution. Participants further specified conditions for acceptable delegation, including personalization, proactive assistance, source traceability, verification of completed actions, and opportunities for oversight.
paragraphs.zh: 开放式回答为这些模式补充了细节，展示了参与者希望委托在实际中如何运作。 许多受访者将大量的AI执行与持续的人类参与相结合，尤其是通过审查、批准或对重要决策的控制。 首选的安排还取决于任务类型。 情感敏感的活动引发了更强的协作支持偏好，而程序性活动则更多地引发了自主执行的请求。 参与者进一步明确了可接受委托的条件，包括个性化、主动协助、来源可追溯性、对已完成操作的验证，以及监督的机会。

Participants separately considered how much of a task AI should perform, whether a human should remain involved, how much leadership the AI should have, and what forms of oversight or verification should accompany its actions. paragraphs.en: Our findings suggest that preferences for AI delegation are more complex than a single continuum from human performance to full automation. Across the evaluated domains, participants varied substantially in how much of a task they wanted AI to perform, how much collaboration they desired, and how much leadership they were willing to give the AI. Trust in the AI, willingness to allow the AI to take a leading role, prior task-specific AI use, and anticipated financial savings were associated with greater automation preference, while concern that automation would reduce personal fulfillment was associated with lower automation preference. Together with the qualitative findings, these results suggest that people make separate judgments about how much work AI should perform, how closely humans should remain involved, and who should retain decision authority.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，对AI委托的偏好比从人类执行到完全自动化的单一连续体更为复杂。 在所评估的各个领域中，参与者在希望AI执行任务的比例、期望协作的程度以及愿意赋予AI的领导权方面存在很大差异。 对AI的信任、允许AI承担主导角色的意愿、以往特定任务中的AI使用经验以及预期的经济节省与更高的自动化偏好相关，而担心自动化会降低个人成就感则与更低的自动化偏好相关。 结合质性研究结果，这些结果表明，人们会对AI应执行多少工作、人类应保持多么紧密的参与以及谁应保留决策权分别做出判断。

paragraphs.en: Our results reinforce prior work showing that willingness to rely on AI depends strongly on the task being performed. Previous studies have found lower acceptance of algorithmic systems for subjective or personally consequential activities and greater preferences for human involvement in such settings ( Castelo et al., 2019 ; Longoni et al., 2019 ) . Our findings extend this pattern across a broad set of everyday and work activities evaluated under a common survey structure. Participants showed greater willingness to automate communication and travel activities, while mental health, physical health, and professional tasks showed lower automation preferences. Trust in AI also varied across domains, with the lowest AI trust observed for Mental Health & Emotional Support. These patterns are consistent with survey research showing that perceptions of AI risks and opportunities differ across application domains ( Schwesig et al., 2023 ) and that context-specific evaluations can be more informative for use intentions than global attitudes toward AI ( Potinteu et al., 2023 ) . Findings in this study further suggest that preferences for agentic AI are shaped not simply by general attitudes toward AI, but by the characteristics and consequences of the activity being delegated.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果强化了此前的研究，即对依赖人工智能的意愿在很大程度上取决于所执行的任务。 以往研究发现，对于主观性较强或对个人影响重大的活动，人们对算法系统的接受度较低，并且在这类情境下更倾向于由人类参与（Castelo et al., 2019; Longoni et al., 2019）。 我们的研究发现将这一模式扩展到在统一调查结构下评估的广泛日常和工作活动中。 参与者对自动化沟通和出行活动的意愿较高，而对心理健康、身体健康和职业任务的自动化偏好较低。 对人工智能的信任也因领域而异，其中「心理健康与情感支持」领域的人工智能信任度最低。 这些模式与调查研究的结果一致，即对人工智能风险与机遇的认知因应用领域而异（Schwesig et al., 2023），并且与对人工智能的总体态度相比，针对具体情境的评估对使用意愿更具参考价值（Potinteu et al., 2023）。 本研究的发现进一步表明，对智能体的偏好并非仅由对人工智能的总体态度决定，还受被委托活动的特征和后果的影响。

paragraphs.en: This task dependence also extends recent work on occupational automation. Shao et al. (2025) found considerable variation in workers’ preferred levels of AI involvement across hundreds of occupational tasks, with workers often favoring human-AI partnership and retaining more human agency than technical experts considered necessary. Our study finds a related pattern outside paid work. This extension is important because much current generative-AI use occurs in non-work settings ( Chatterji et al., 2025 ) , yet systematic comparisons of delegation preferences across everyday domains remain limited. By asking each participant to evaluate tasks across the same nine domains using a common set of measures, our design shows how delegation preferences change within individuals as the activity changes.
paragraphs.zh: 这种任务依赖性也扩展了近期关于职业自动化的研究。Shao 等人 （2025）发现，在数百项职业任务中，劳动者偏好的 AI 参与程度存在很大差异，劳动者往往更倾向于人机协作，并保留比技术专家认为必要的更多的自主权。 我们的研究在有偿工作之外的领域发现了类似的模式。 这一扩展很重要，因为当前许多生成式 AI 的使用发生在非工作场景中（Chatterji 等人，2025），然而针对日常各领域中委派偏好的系统性比较仍然有限。 通过要求每位参与者使用统一的一组测量指标评估相同九个领域的任务，我们的设计展示了随着活动的变化，个体内部的委派偏好如何发生变化。

paragraphs.en: Our findings suggest that AI delegation is better understood as a multidimensional configuration than as a single level of automation, which echoes the findings from previous studies ( Lubars and Tan, 2019 ; Bansal et al., 2021 ; Buçinca et al., 2021 ; Sivaraman et al., 2023 ) . Desired AI leadership was independently associated with greater automation preference, while desired human–AI collaboration was not. This suggests that collaboration and automation should not be treated as opposing ends of the same continuum. A user may want an AI to perform substantial portions of a task while still wanting to remain involved in the process, and involvement does not necessarily imply that the human or AI must fully control the activity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，将AI委派理解为一种多维配置比将其理解为单一的自动化水平更为恰当，这与以往研究的发现相呼应（Lubars and Tan, 2019；Bansal et al., 2021；Buçinca et al., 2021；Sivaraman et al., 2023）。 期望的AI主导权与更强的自动化偏好独立相关，而期望的人机协作则不然。 这表明，协作与自动化不应被视为同一连续体上的对立两端。 用户可能希望智能体执行任务的相当部分，同时仍希望参与整个过程，而参与并不一定意味着人类或智能体必须完全控制该活动。

paragraphs.en: The qualitative findings provide further evidence of this distinction. Assistive or collaborative support appeared in 66.2% of codable responses, autonomous execution appeared in 48.0%, and both appeared together in 25.6%. Participants frequently described workflows in which AI could complete substantial portions of an activity while human authority was preserved at important decision points. One participant wanted an AI to act “autonomously” while retaining the ability to “approve and review major changes,” while another wanted an agent to coordinate available appointments but request approval before confirming them. Emotionally sensitive tasks were more often described in collaborative terms, whereas procedural activities such as appointment scheduling and translation more frequently elicited autonomous execution. This distinction is compatible with prior evidence that people often prefer AI assistance over outright replacement of human professionals ( Antes et al., 2021 ; Longoni et al., 2019 ) and with observations that clinicians selectively accept, reject, or “negotiate” components of AI recommendations ( Sivaraman et al., 2023 ) . Together, these findings illustrate a recurring preference for bounded autonomy, allowing AI to independently execute substantial portions of a task while preserving human authority at consequential decision points.

paragraphs.en: Aforementioned findings also extend previous work on automation preference by suggesting that delegation itself may be measured too coarsely when represented only as how much of a task a user wants AI to perform. We conceptualize agentic delegation as involving several related but distinct dimensions: execution , or how much of the task the AI performs; collaboration , or how much the human remains involved in the process; and leadership , or how much the AI directs the activity. Our qualitative findings further surface authority as an important consideration: whether consequential actions remain subject to human approval, review, or override. These dimensions need not move together. Users may delegate execution without fully delegating authority, or remain extensively involved while allowing an AI to lead substantial portions of an activity. Agentic AI should therefore not be understood solely in terms of a level of automation, but also in terms of how execution, involvement, and decision authority are configured between human and AI actors. Future studies may benefit from measuring these dimensions separately rather than treating human involvement and automation as mutually exclusive.
paragraphs.zh: 上述发现还拓展了此前关于自动化偏好的研究，表明当委托仅被表示为用户希望 AI 执行任务的程度时，其测量方式可能过于粗糙。 我们将智能体式委托概念化为几个相关但不同的维度：执行，即 AI 承担任务的比例；协作，即人类在过程中保持参与的程度；以及领导，即 AI 主导活动的程度。 我们的定性发现进一步揭示出权限是一个重要考量：即重大行动是否仍需经过人类的批准、审查或否决。 这些维度不必同步变动。 用户可以在不完全下放权限的情况下委托执行，也可以在深度参与的同时允许 AI 主导活动的相当部分。 因此，智能体式 AI 不应仅从自动化水平来理解，还应从执行、参与和决策权限在人类与 AI 行动者之间如何配置来理解。 未来的研究可以分别测量这些维度，而不是将人类参与与自动化视为互斥关系，或将有所裨益。

sents.en: Aforementioned findings also extend previous work on automation preference by suggesting that delegation itself may be measured too coarsely when represented only as how much of a task a user wants AI to perform.
sents.zh: 上述发现还拓展了此前关于自动化偏好的研究，表明当委托仅被表示为用户希望 AI 执行任务的程度时，其测量方式可能过于粗糙。

sents.en: We conceptualize agentic delegation as involving several related but distinct dimensions: execution , or how much of the task the AI performs; collaboration , or how much the human remains involved in the process; and leadership , or how much the AI directs the activity.
sents.zh: 我们将智能体式委托概念化为几个相关但不同的维度：执行，即 AI 承担任务的比例；协作，即人类在过程中保持参与的程度；以及领导，即 AI 主导活动的程度。

sents.en: Our qualitative findings further surface authority as an important consideration: whether consequential actions remain subject to human approval, review, or override.
sents.zh: 我们的定性发现进一步揭示出权限是一个重要考量：即重大行动是否仍需经过人类的批准、审查或否决。

sents.en: These dimensions need not move together.
sents.zh: 这些维度不必同步变动。

sents.en: Users may delegate execution without fully delegating authority, or remain extensively involved while allowing an AI to lead substantial portions of an activity.
sents.zh: 用户可以在不完全下放权限的情况下委托执行，也可以在深度参与的同时允许 AI 主导活动的相当部分。

sents.en: Agentic AI should therefore not be understood solely in terms of a level of automation, but also in terms of how execution, involvement, and decision authority are configured between human and AI actors.
sents.zh: 因此，智能体式 AI 不应仅从自动化水平来理解，还应从执行、参与和决策权限在人类与 AI 行动者之间如何配置来理解。

sents.en: Future studies may benefit from measuring these dimensions separately rather than treating human involvement and automation as mutually exclusive.
sents.zh: 未来的研究可以分别测量这些维度，而不是将人类参与与自动化视为互斥关系，或将有所裨益。

paragraphs.en: Our findings suggest that decisions about AI delegation involve not only the benefits and risks of automation, but also the value of performing an activity oneself. Aligned with previous works, we found that trust in AI was strongly associated with greater automation preference ( Lee and See, 2004 ) , while desired AI leadership, prior task-specific AI use, and anticipated financial savings were also consistently associated with greater automation ( Hoff and Bashir, 2015 ) . By contrast, concern that automation would make life less exciting or fulfilling predicted lower automation preference. This finding is consistent with prior work showing that AI assistance can alter users’ sense of ownership, accomplishment, and engagement even when it improves task performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究发现表明，关于AI委托的决策不仅涉及自动化的收益与风险，还涉及亲自从事某项活动的价值。 与以往研究一致，我们发现对AI的信任与更强的自动化偏好密切相关（Lee and See, 2004），而期望AI发挥主导作用、既往的任务特定AI使用以及预期的财务节省也与更高的自动化接受度持续相关（Hoff and Bashir, 2015）。 相比之下，担心自动化会使生活失去乐趣或成就感则预示着更低的自动化偏好。 这一发现与既往研究一致，即即使AI辅助能提升任务表现，它仍可能改变用户的归属感、成就感与投入感。

sents.en: Our findings suggest that decisions about AI delegation involve not only the benefits and risks of automation, but also the value of performing an activity oneself.
sents.zh: 我们的研究发现表明，关于AI委托的决策不仅涉及自动化的收益与风险，还涉及亲自从事某项活动的价值。

sents.en: By contrast, concern that automation would make life less exciting or fulfilling predicted lower automation preference.
sents.zh: 相比之下，担心自动化会使生活失去乐趣或成就感则预示着更低的自动化偏好。

sents.en: This finding is consistent with prior work showing that AI assistance can alter users’ sense of ownership, accomplishment, and engagement even when it improves task performance.
sents.zh: 这一发现与既往研究一致，即即使AI辅助能提升任务表现，它仍可能改变用户的归属感、成就感与投入感。

paragraphs.en: We characterize this consideration as the experiential value of human involvement, i.e., the value users derive from participating in the process of performing an activity, beyond the instrumental value of its outcome. For some activities, the process of performing the task may itself have value. Learning, creativity, communication, and personal decision making may contribute to identity, enjoyment, or a sense of accomplishment in ways that are lost when the activity is fully delegated ( Draxler et al., 2024 ) . Consequently, increasing the technical capability of an agent does not necessarily imply that users will want greater automation. Systems may provide greater value when they reduce tedious or burdensome portions of an activity while preserving the aspects users want to perform themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这一考量定义为人类参与的体验价值，即用户从参与执行活动过程中获得的价值，超越其结果的工具性价值。 对于某些活动而言，执行任务的过程本身可能就具有价值。 学习、创造力、沟通和个人决策可能以有助于身份认同、愉悦感或成就感的方式产生价值，而当活动被完全委托出去时，这些价值便会丧失（Draxler et al., 2024）。 因此，提高智能体的技术能力并不必然意味着用户会想要更高程度的自动化。 当系统减少活动中乏味或繁重的部分，同时保留用户希望自己完成的内容时，它们可能提供更大的价值。

paragraphs.en: Technology-acceptance models have long emphasized perceived usefulness and effort expectancy ( Davis, 1989 ; Venkatesh et al., 2003 ) , while consumer-oriented extensions explicitly incorporate price value as a tradeoff between perceived benefits and monetary costs ( Venkatesh et al., 2012 ) . Our willingness-to-pay analyses further distinguish perceived value from payment magnitude. Greater automation preference, trust in AI, and expected savings were associated with whether respondents were willing to pay for an AI service at all, whereas expected savings and additional expenses were more consistently associated with the amount respondents were willing to pay among positive responses. This distinction suggests that willingness to adopt a paid agentic service and valuation of that service are related but separable decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 技术接受模型长期强调感知有用性和努力期望（Davis, 1989；Venkatesh 等，2003），而面向消费者的扩展模型则明确将价格价值纳入考量，即感知收益与货币成本之间的权衡（Venkatesh 等，2012）。 我们的支付意愿分析进一步将感知价值与支付金额区分开来。 更高的自动化偏好、对AI的信任以及预期节省，与受访者是否愿意为AI服务付费相关；而在愿意付费的受访者中，预期节省和额外支出与其愿意支付的金额的相关性更为一致。 这一区分表明，是否愿意采用付费的智能体服务与对该智能体服务的估值是相关但可分离的决策。

paragraphs.en: The findings also complicate a simple interpretation of privacy as a direct barrier to AI adoption. Privacy concern varied meaningfully across domains and was greatest in Mental Health & Emotional Support and Personal Finance, followed by Medicine & Physical Health and Workplace & Professional Support. However, privacy concern was not independently associated with automation preference after accounting for trust, AI leadership, prior task-specific AI use, expected financial consequences, personal stakes, domain, and respondent characteristics. Privacy therefore appears to operate as one consideration within a broader task-level evaluation rather than as a simple veto against AI use. More broadly, this finding suggests that delegation decisions concern not only what users risk by giving information to an AI, but also what they may give up by giving the activity itself to an AI. The former concerns informational exposure; the latter concerns the experiential value of continued human participation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现也使一种将隐私视为 AI 采用直接障碍的简单解读变得复杂。 隐私担忧在不同领域之间存在显著差异，在「心理健康与情感支持」和「个人财务」领域最高，其次是「医学与身体健康」和「职场与专业支持」。 然而，在控制了信任、AI 领导力、先前的特定任务 AI 使用、预期的经济后果、个人利害关系、领域以及受访者特征之后，隐私担忧与自动化偏好之间并无独立关联。 因此，隐私似乎只是在更广泛的任务层面评估中的一个考量因素，而非对 AI 使用的简单否决。 更广泛地说，这一发现表明，委托决策不仅涉及用户因向 AI 提供信息而承担的风险，还涉及他们因将活动本身交给 AI 而可能失去的东西。 前者关乎信息暴露；后者关乎持续的人类参与所带来的体验价值。

paragraphs.en: This pattern is particularly important for increasingly personalized agents. Participants frequently described wanting systems that could adapt to their preferences, track progress, monitor changing conditions, and proactively provide assistance. For example, one participant wanted a language-learning system to “adapt to my level and track my progress,” while another wanted commute assistance to incorporate “real-time traffic, weather, and my schedule.” These capabilities may improve usefulness while also requiring greater access to personal information. The resulting tension between personalization and privacy suggests that future agent designs should give users clearer control over what information is retained, how it is used, and which actions depend on it.
paragraphs.zh: 这种模式对于日益个性化的智能体尤为重要。 参与者经常描述希望系统能够适应他们的偏好、跟踪进度、监测变化的情况并主动提供帮助。 例如，一位参与者希望语言学习系统能「适应我的水平并跟踪我的进度」，而另一位参与者希望通勤辅助能整合「实时交通、天气和我的日程」。这些能力可能会提升实用性，但同时也需要获取更多个人信息。 由此产生的个性化与隐私之间的张力表明，未来的智能体设计应让用户更清晰地控制哪些信息被保留、如何被使用，以及哪些操作依赖于这些信息。

paragraphs.en: The qualitative findings also point to the importance of accountability when AI systems move from generating recommendations to taking actions. Participants requested citations, links, intermediate outputs, and confirmation that actions had been completed. In research tasks, respondents asked for source-level traceability, while in action-oriented tasks some wanted proof that the AI had successfully carried out the requested action. These findings suggest that transparency for agentic systems should include not only explanations of recommendations, but also visibility into what the system did, what information it used, and whether the action succeeded.
paragraphs.zh: 定性研究结果还指出，当AI系统从生成建议转向执行操作时，问责制的重要性。 参与者要求提供引用、链接、中间输出，以及操作已完成的确认。 在研究型任务中，受访者要求具备来源级别的可追溯性，而在面向操作的任务中，一些受访者希望获得AI已成功执行所请求操作的证明。 这些发现表明，智能体系统的透明度不仅应包括对建议的解释，还应包括对系统做了什么、使用了哪些信息以及操作是否成功的可见性。

paragraphs.en: Overall, our findings suggest that the central design problem for agentic AI is not simply how much to automate, but how to configure delegation between humans and AI. Participants made distinct judgments about how much work an AI should execute, how closely humans should remain involved, how much leadership the AI should hold, and where consequential decision authority should remain. At the same time, these judgments reflected not only instrumental considerations such as trust and financial benefit, but also the experiential value users attached to participating in activities themselves. Together, these findings shift the design question from “How much should the AI automate?” toward “What should be delegated, under whose authority, and what forms of human participation should be preserved?” General-purpose agents may therefore benefit from configurable boundaries of autonomy that allow users to delegate execution while specifying approval checkpoints, retain meaningful participation in selected parts of an activity, and vary AI leadership across tasks or stages of the same task. Such designs would treat successful agentic AI not as the maximization of automation, but as the alignment of delegation with how users want work, authority, and meaningful participation to be distributed.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，智能体AI（agentic AI）的核心设计问题并不在于简单地决定自动化程度的高低，而在于如何配置人类与AI之间的委托关系。 参与者就以下问题作出了不同的判断：AI应执行多少工作、人类应保持多紧密的参与、AI应掌握多少领导权，以及重要的决策权应保留在何处。 同时，这些判断不仅反映了信任和经济收益等工具性考量，也反映了用户从亲身参与活动中获得的价值体验。 综合来看，这些发现将设计问题从「AI应该自动化多少？」转向「应该委托什么、由谁掌权、以及应保留哪些形式的人类参与？」因此，通用智能体可以受益于可配置的自主权边界，这种边界允许用户在委托执行任务的同时指定审批节点，在活动的特定部分保留有意义的参与，并在不同任务或同一任务的不同阶段调整AI的领导程度。 这样的设计将把成功的智能体AI视为委托与用户期望相契合的产物，而非自动化的最大化——即让工作、决策权以及有意义的参与按照用户的意愿进行分配。

sents.zh: 同时，这些判断不仅反映了信任和经济收益等工具性考量，也反映了用户从亲身参与活动中获得的价值体验。

sents.en: Together, these findings shift the design question from “How much should the AI automate?” toward “What should be delegated, under whose authority, and what forms of human participation should be preserved?” General-purpose agents may therefore benefit from configurable boundaries of autonomy that allow users to delegate execution while specifying approval checkpoints, retain meaningful participation in selected parts of an activity, and vary AI leadership across tasks or stages of the same task.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些发现将设计问题从「AI应该自动化多少？」转向「应该委托什么、由谁掌权、以及应保留哪些形式的人类参与？」因此，通用智能体可以受益于可配置的自主权边界，这种边界允许用户在委托执行任务的同时指定审批节点，在活动的特定部分保留有意义的参与，并在不同任务或同一任务的不同阶段调整AI的领导程度。

sents.en: Such designs would treat successful agentic AI not as the maximization of automation, but as the alignment of delegation with how users want work, authority, and meaningful participation to be distributed.
sents.zh: 这样的设计将把成功的智能体AI视为委托与用户期望相契合的产物，而非自动化的最大化——即让工作、决策权以及有意义的参与按照用户的意愿进行分配。

paragraphs.en: This study has several limitations. First, participants evaluated hypothetical daily life scenarios rather than interacting with functioning AI agents in these scenarios. Stated preferences may change when users experience real system errors, benefits, or interaction costs. Second, participants were relatively familiar with AI technologies: most reported substantial AI knowledge, high familiarity with LLMs, and frequent use of systems such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Future work should examine whether similar patterns emerge among populations with less prior experience using AI who may reason about delegation differently.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究存在若干局限性。 首先，参与者评估的是假设性的日常生活场景，而非在这些场景中与可实际运行的智能体进行交互。 当用户体验到真实的系统错误、收益或交互成本时，其陈述的偏好可能会发生改变。 其次，参与者对人工智能技术相对熟悉：大多数人报告具有较多的人工智能知识，对大语言模型高度熟悉，并频繁使用 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 等系统。 未来的研究应考察在使用人工智能经验较少、可能以不同方式思考委托问题的人群中，是否会出现类似的模式。

sents.en: This study has several limitations.
sents.zh: 本研究存在若干局限性。

sents.en: First, participants evaluated hypothetical daily life scenarios rather than interacting with functioning AI agents in these scenarios.
sents.zh: 首先，参与者评估的是假设性的日常生活场景，而非在这些场景中与可实际运行的智能体进行交互。

sents.en: Stated preferences may change when users experience real system errors, benefits, or interaction costs.
sents.zh: 当用户体验到真实的系统错误、收益或交互成本时，其陈述的偏好可能会发生改变。

sents.en: Second, participants were relatively familiar with AI technologies: most reported substantial AI knowledge, high familiarity with LLMs, and frequent use of systems such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
sents.zh: 其次，参与者对人工智能技术相对熟悉：大多数人报告具有较多的人工智能知识，对大语言模型高度熟悉，并频繁使用 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 等系统。

sents.en: Future work should examine whether similar patterns emerge among populations with less prior experience using AI who may reason about delegation differently.
sents.zh: 未来的研究应考察在使用人工智能经验较少、可能以不同方式思考委托问题的人群中，是否会出现类似的模式。

paragraphs.en: Third, the study prioritized breadth across activities, meaning that respondents evaluated one randomly selected task within each domain rather than all possible tasks. The open-ended qualitative question was also presented only when respondents expressed at least some willingness to involve AI, so these responses primarily characterize how willing users want delegation to occur rather than why some users reject AI involvement altogether. Future studies could directly compare the preferences of users who accept and reject delegation and examine whether these preferences change through sustained interaction with AI agents in daily life tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，本研究优先考虑跨活动的广度，即受访者在每个领域中只评估一项随机选取的任务，而非所有可能的任务。 开放式定性问题也仅在受访者表示出至少一定程度的让 AI 参与的意愿时才呈现，因此这些回答主要刻画的是用户希望委托到何种程度，而非为什么某些用户完全拒绝 AI 的参与。 未来的研究可以直接比较接受委托和拒绝委托的用户偏好，并检验这些偏好在日常生活中与智能体持续互动的过程中是否会发生变化。

sents.en: Third, the study prioritized breadth across activities, meaning that respondents evaluated one randomly selected task within each domain rather than all possible tasks.
sents.zh: 第三，本研究优先考虑跨活动的广度，即受访者在每个领域中只评估一项随机选取的任务，而非所有可能的任务。

sents.en: The open-ended qualitative question was also presented only when respondents expressed at least some willingness to involve AI, so these responses primarily characterize how willing users want delegation to occur rather than why some users reject AI involvement altogether.

sents.en: Future studies could directly compare the preferences of users who accept and reject delegation and examine whether these preferences change through sustained interaction with AI agents in daily life tasks.
sents.zh: 未来的研究可以直接比较接受委托和拒绝委托的用户偏好，并检验这些偏好在日常生活中与智能体持续互动的过程中是否会发生变化。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the present analysis examined average relationships across domains rather than testing whether the relationships between trust, leadership, privacy, fulfillment, and automation differ significantly from one domain to another. Future work could examine these interactions directly and investigate whether different forms of delegation emerge for particular categories of activity. Longitudinal studies would also help determine whether users maintain the same boundaries around AI authority after experiencing successful delegation, system failures, or changes in trust over time.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，本分析考察的是跨领域的平均关系，而未检验信任、领导力、隐私、满足感与自动化之间的关系在不同领域之间是否存在显著差异。 未来的工作可以直接考察这些交互作用，并研究在特定类别的活动中是否会出现不同形式的委托。 纵向研究还将有助于确定用户在经历了成功的委托、系统故障或信任随时间发生变化之后，是否会维持对AI权威的相同边界。

sents.en: Finally, the present analysis examined average relationships across domains rather than testing whether the relationships between trust, leadership, privacy, fulfillment, and automation differ significantly from one domain to another.
sents.zh: 最后，本分析考察的是跨领域的平均关系，而未检验信任、领导力、隐私、满足感与自动化之间的关系在不同领域之间是否存在显著差异。

sents.en: Longitudinal studies would also help determine whether users maintain the same boundaries around AI authority after experiencing successful delegation, system failures, or changes in trust over time.
sents.zh: 纵向研究还将有助于确定用户在经历了成功的委托、系统故障或信任随时间发生变化之后，是否会维持对AI权威的相同边界。

paragraphs.en: AI agents are increasingly capable of acting on users’ behalf across a wide range of everyday and work activities, but willingness to delegate is highly task dependent. Through an online survey that collected responses from 289 U.S. adults across 45 scenarios spanning nine life domains, we found that automation preferences varied substantially by domain. Greater trust in the AI, desired AI leadership, prior task-specific AI use, and anticipated financial savings were associated with greater automation preference, whereas concern about losing personal fulfillment was associated with lower automation preference. Privacy concern also varied across domains, but it did not independently predict automation preference after adjustment. Our findings further show that delegation is not well captured by a single continuum from human performance to full automation. Participants distinguished among how much of a task the AI should execute, how much collaboration they wanted, how much leadership the AI should hold, and where human authority should remain. Qualitative analysis on open-ended responses revealed a preference for bounded autonomy, in which AI could perform substantial portions of a task while humans retained oversight, approval, or final decision authority. These results suggest that the design of agentic AI should focus not only on increasing capability, but also on configuring the boundaries of delegation. Systems that allow users to separately control execution, collaboration, leadership, and authority may better reflect how people want responsibility to be distributed between themselves and increasingly autonomous AI agents.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能智能体日益有能力在广泛的日常和工作活动中代表用户行事，但用户委托的意愿高度依赖于具体任务。 通过一项在线调查，我们收集了289名美国成年人在横跨九个生活领域的45个场景中的回答，发现自动化偏好在不同领域之间存在很大差异。 对人工智能更大的信任、期望由人工智能主导、以往在特定任务上使用人工智能的经历以及预期的财务节省，与更高的自动化偏好相关；而对失去个人成就感的担忧则与更低的自动化偏好相关。 隐私担忧在不同领域之间也存在差异，但经过调整后，它并不能独立预测自动化偏好。 我们的研究结果进一步表明，从人类执行到完全自动化的单一连续体并不能很好地刻画委托行为。 参与者区分了人工智能应执行任务的多少、他们希望有多少协作、人工智能应掌握多少主导权，以及人类权威应保留在哪些环节。 对开放式回答的定性分析揭示了一种对有界自主性的偏好，即人工智能可以执行任务的大部分内容，而人类保留监督、批准或最终决策权。 这些结果表明，智能体人工智能的设计不仅应关注提升能力，还应关注如何配置委托的边界。 允许用户分别控制执行、协作、主导权和权威的系统，可能更好地反映人们希望在自身与日益自主的人工智能智能体之间如何分配责任。

paragraphs.en: You are being asked to participate in a voluntary research study. The purpose of this study is to understand how individuals integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents into daily routines, and their attitudes toward expanded automation and augmentation by AI systems. Your participation is expected to last approximately thirty minutes. The risks associated with this research are minimal, and are no greater than those you ordinarily encounter in your daily activities. The benefits of participating in this research include contributing to a broader understanding of how AI technologies are used in everyday life and decision-making, while informing the development of AI agents that align with user needs and desires.
